Service to manage electronic fund transfers via EFT payment method with PAYBC system code.

Entry points: `get_payment_method_code()` (public, no check shown) returns PaymentMethod.EFT.value; `get_payment_system_code()` (public, no check shown) returns PaymentSystem.PAYBC.value; `create_account(identifier, contact_info, payment_info)` (public, no check shown) creates CfsAccountModel with status PENDING and payment_method EFT; `create_invoice(payment_account, line_items, invoice)` (public, no check shown) calls `ensure_no_payment_blockers()` then does nothing (invoice references created by separate create_cfs_invoices job); `complete_post_invoice(invoice, invoice_reference)` (public, no check shown) calls `_release_payment()` with invoice; `get_default_invoice_status()` (public, no check shown) returns InvoiceStatus.APPROVED.value; `create_payment(payment_account, invoice, payment_date, paid_amount)` (public, no check shown) returns PaymentModel with method EFT, status COMPLETED, system PAYBC, invoice_number prefixed by config EFT_INVOICE_PREFIX, receipt_number set to invoice.id; `process_cfs_refund(invoice, payment_account, refund_partial)` (public, no check shown) - if invoice status is APPROVED and no active InvoiceReference and no EFTCreditInvoiceLinks exist, returns CANCELLED; if active completed consolidated InvoiceReference exists, raises BusinessException(Error.INVALID_CONSOLIDATED_REFUND); otherwise calls EFTRefundService.handle_invoice_refund(); `create_invoice_reference(invoice, invoice_number, reference_number)` (static, no check shown) finds or creates InvoiceReferenceModel, sets status ACTIVE; `create_receipt(invoice, payment)` (static, no check shown) returns ReceiptModel; `apply_payment_action(short_name_id, auth_account_id)` (static, checks auth_account_id not None and PaymentAccountModel.find_by_auth_account_id returns non-None, raises BusinessException(Error.EFT_PAYMENT_ACTION_ACCOUNT_ID_REQUIRED) if fails) calls EftService.process_owing_statements(); `cancel_payment_action(short_name_id, auth_account_id, invoice_id)` (static, checks auth_account_id not None and payment_account found, raises BusinessException(Error.EFT_PAYMENT_ACTION_ACCOUNT_ID_REQUIRED) if fails) - gets EFTCreditInvoiceLinks with status PENDING via `_get_shortname_invoice_links()`, for each calls EFTRefundService.return_eft_credit() to status CANCELLED, collects link_group_ids, deletes associated EFTHistoryModels, flushes to database.

GOTCHA: `process_cfs_refund()` return value is inconsistent - sometimes returns InvoiceStatus value string, sometimes returns what EFTRefundService.handle_invoice_refund() returns (type unclear); consolidated refund rejection message does not explain why consolidation blocks refunds.

structured.condensed:
Reverses EFT payments applied to invoices on a statement, returning credits to a short name's EFT account and notifying account admins of the adjusted balance.

Entry point `reverse_payment_action(short_name_id, statement_id)` is a static method; this chunk shows no permission check. It requires a non-null `statement_id`, raising `BusinessException(Error.EFT_PAYMENT_ACTION_STATEMENT_ID_REQUIRED)` if absent. Fetches credit-invoice links for the short name and statement, validates them (no links in PENDING, PENDING_REFUND, or REFUNDED status; payment date must be within 60 days), then iterates each link. Skips invoices in REFUND_REQUESTED, REFUNDED, or CANCELLED status. For PAID invoices only, calls `EFTRefundService.return_eft_credit(link)` to reverse the credit, creates a new `EFTCreditInvoiceLinkModel` with status PENDING_REFUND, and accumulates reversed amounts. After iteration, creates an `EFTHistory` record via `EFTHistoryService.create_statement_reverse()` with the total reversed amount and current EFT credit balance. Sends email notification to payment account admins with reversed amount and recalculated outstanding balance. All database writes are flushed individually but within a single request (no explicit transaction control shown). Commented-out partner disbursement code suggests incomplete feature. Helper `get_pending_payment_count()` returns a subquery for PENDING link counts by payment account. Helper `_get_shortname_invoice_links()` queries links by short name, account, and status list, optionally filtered by invoice. Helper `_validate_reversal_credit_invoice_links()` enforces the validation rules above. Helper `_send_reversed_payment_notification()` decorated with `@user_context`, retrieves admin contacts via external `get_account_admin_users()` call and sends email via `send_email()`. Helper `get_statement_credit_invoice_links()` retrieves the most recent link per invoice for a statement and short name, excluding cancelled links.

GOTCHA: No duplicate guard prevents reversing the same statement twice. GOTCHA: Reversed credits are recorded (EFTHistory) after individual link processing completes; partial reversal (if an invoice fails mid-loop) leaves EFTHistory inconsistent with actual reversed links. GOTCHA: Email sending failures are not retried and do not block the reversal. GOTCHA: Partner disbursement logic is commented out and incomplete.

structured.condensed:
Manages EFT short name model operations: payment actions, link creation and deletion, and lookups in a BC Registries accounting system.

**Entry points and permission checks:**
- `process_payment_action(short_name_id, request)`: extracts `action`, `statementId`, `accountId` from request; this chunk shows no check. Routes to `EftService.apply_payment_action()`, `cancel_payment_action()`, or `reverse_payment_action()` based on action value—`APPLY_CREDITS`, `CANCEL`, or `REVERSE`—or raises `BusinessException(Error.EFT_PAYMENT_ACTION_UNSUPPORTED)` for unknown action. Commits on success; on exception, rolls back and re-raises.
- `patch_shortname(short_name_id, request)`: updates `email` and `cas_supplier_number` on matched `EFTShortnameModel`; strips whitespace; this chunk shows no check. Returns updated record via `find_by_short_name_id()`.
- `patch_shortname_link(link_id, request)`: checks `statusCode` is in `[EFTShortnameStatus.INACTIVE.value]`; raises `BusinessException(Error.EFT_SHORT_NAME_LINK_INVALID_STATUS)` if not. Updates `EFTShortnameLinksModel.status_code`; returns via `find_link_by_id()`.
- `create_shortname_link(short_name_id, auth_account_id, **kwargs)`: decorated `@user_context`; extracts `user.user_name`, `user.name` from kwargs. Checks `auth_account_id` not None; checks no active link exists (calls `find_by_auth_account_id_state()` for `LINKED` or `PENDING`); raises `BusinessException(Error.EFT_SHORT_NAME_ALREADY_MAPPED)` if found. Creates or reactivates `EFTShortnameLinksModel` (calls `EFTShortnameLinksModel.find_inactive_link()`), sets status `PENDING`, saves, flushes, calls `EftService.process_owing_statements(is_new_link=True)`, then returns via `find_link_by_id()`.
- `delete_shortname_link(short_name_link_id)`: checks status is `PENDING`; raises `BusinessException(Error.EFT_SHORT_NAME_LINK_INVALID_STATUS)` if not. Deletes record.
- `get_shortname_links(short_name_id)`, `find_by_short_name_id()`, `find_by_auth_account_id()`, `find_by_auth_account_id_state()`, `find_link_by_id()`, `search()`: read-only lookups; this chunk shows no check.

**Data flow:**
Input shapes: request dict with `action`, `statementId`, `accountId`, `email`, `casSupplierNumber`, `statusCode`. Output: unstructured `EFTShortnames`, `EFTShortnameLinkSchema` objects, or dict with `items`, `state_total`, `page`, `limit`, `total`.
Calls out to `EftService.apply_payment_action()`, `cancel_payment_action()`, `reverse_payment_action()`, `process_owing_statements()`, `get_pending_payment_count()`.
Reads `EFTShortnameModel`, `EFTShortnameLinksModel`, `PaymentAccountModel`.

**GOTCHA:** `create_shortname_link()` checks for active links via `find_by_auth_account_id_state()` but does not check authorization of the caller to link their account.
**GOTCHA:** `patch_shortname()` and `patch_shortname_link()` show no permission check.
**GOTCHA:** Exception in `process_payment_action()` is caught broadly as `Exception`, with no logging before re-raise.

{"condensed":"Manages EFT short name model operations: payment actions, link creation and deletion, and lookups in a BC Registries accounting system.

**Entry points and permission checks:**
- `process_payment_action(short_name_id, request)`: extracts `action`, `statementId`, `accountId` from request; this chunk shows no check. Routes to `EftService.apply_payment_action()`, `cancel_payment_action()`, or `reverse_payment_action()` based on action value—`APPLY_CREDITS`, `CANCEL`, or `REVERSE`—or raises `BusinessException(Error.EFT_PAYMENT_ACTION_UNSUPPORTED)` for unknown action. Commits on success; on exception, rolls back and re-raises.
- `patch_shortname(short_name_id, request)`: updates `email` and `cas_supplier_number` on matched `EFTShortnameModel`; strips whitespace; this chunk shows no check. Returns updated record via `find_by_short_name_id()`.
- `patch_shortname_link(link_id, request)`: checks `statusCode` is in `[EFTShortnameStatus.INACTIVE.value]`; raises `BusinessException(Error.EFT_SHORT_NAME_LINK_INVALID_STATUS)` if not. Updates `EFTShortnameLinksModel.status_code`; returns via `find_link_by_id()`.
- `create_shortname_link(short_name_id, auth_account_id, **kwargs)`: decorated `@user_context`; extracts `user.user_name`, `user.name` from kwargs. Checks `auth_account_id` not None; checks no active link exists (calls `find_by_auth_account_id_state()` for `LINKED` or `PENDING`); raises `BusinessException(Error.EFT_SHORT_NAME_ALREADY_MAPPED)` if found. Creates or reactivates `EFTShortnameLinksModel` (calls `EFTShortnameLinksModel.find_inactive_link()`), sets status `PENDING`, saves, flushes, calls `EftService.process_owing_statements(is_new_link=True)`, then returns via `find_link_by_id()`.
- `delete_shortname_link(short_name_link_id)`: checks status is `PENDING`; raises `BusinessException(Error.EFT_SHORT_NAME_LINK_INVALID_STATUS)` if not. Deletes record.
- `get_shortname_links(short_name_id)`, `find_by_short_name_id()`, `find_by_auth_account_id()`, `find_by_auth_account_id_state()`, `find_link_by_id()`, `search()`: read-only lookups; this chunk shows no check.

Calls out to `EftService.apply_payment_action()`, `cancel_payment_action()`, `reverse_payment_action()`, `process_owing_statements()`, `get_pending_payment_count()`.
Reads `EFTShortnameModel`, `EFTShortnameLinksModel`, `PaymentAccountModel`.

structured.condensed:
Email notification service that dispatches transactional emails to recipients through GCNotify and renders short-name refund or payment-reversal emails from templates.

Entry points: `send_email(recipients, subject, body)` callable by any caller, this chunk shows no check; `ShortNameRefundEmailContent.render_body(is_for_client)` renders either client or staff refund template; `_render_payment_reversed_template(params)` renders payment reversal template.

`send_email` loops each recipient, builds notify_body with recipients, subject, content.body, posts to NOTIFY_API_ENDPOINT/notify/ with service account token as Bearer auth and JSON content-type. Logs success or catches and logs any Exception without re-raising. Returns True only if at least one post succeeded.

`render_body` loads templates from project_root/templates, selects eft_refund_notification_client.html or eft_refund_notification_staff.html based on is_for_client boolean, renders with self.to_dict().

`_render_payment_reversed_template` loads eft_reverse_payment.html, constructs statementUrl from AUTH_WEB_URL config and params['accountId'], merges into params, renders.

GOTCHA: `send_email` swallows all exceptions and returns success=False on any failure without distinguishing; comment says HTML body ideally should not bypass GCNotify but code permits it.

structured.condensed: Creates a routing slip (payment record linking multiple payments to an account) in FAS, or links one to a parent slip, or updates its status. Entry points: `create` (classmethod, @user_context decorator implies user check, no check shown in chunk), `do_link` (classmethod, no caller check shown), `update` (classmethod, @user_context decorator, validates user role for VOID/CORRECTION/REFUND_AUTHORIZED/WRITE_OFF_AUTHORIZED status changes via `_check_roles_for_status_update`, aborting 403 on role failure). Creates a PaymentAccountModel and CfsAccountModel with PENDING status, a RoutingSlipModel, and PaymentModel records for each payment in the request, all flushed then committed. Validates routing slip number is unique, all payments share one payment method, and cheque payments have paymentDate. On `update` with status=NSF, sums totals of routing slip and children to reverse remaining_amount. On status=VOID, checks routing_slip.invoices is empty, zeroes remaining_amount. On status=CORRECTION, calculates new total and remaining_amount, creates CommentModel with correction details, updates child payment records' paid_amount and cheque_receipt_number, then may reset status to COMPLETE or ACTIVE based on CfsAccountStatus. GOTCHA: `create` shows no permission check despite @user_context. GOTCHA: `do_link` shows no permission check. GOTCHA: CfsAccountModel always created with PENDING status; transition to other status not shown. GOTCHA: NSF total reversal uses sum of routing_slip and children but does not atomically prevent concurrent modifications. GOTCHA: VOID check on invoices happens after status is set, risking partial state.

structured.condensed:
Service to manage routing slip status transitions and validate allowed state changes.

Reads the routing slip's current status from RoutingSlipModel and looks up allowed transitions in STATUS_TRANSITIONS dict (ACTIVE→HOLD/NSF/REFUND_REQUESTED/WRITE_OFF_REQUESTED/VOID/CORRECTION; COMPLETE→NSF/VOID/CORRECTION; HOLD→ACTIVE/NSF/VOID; REFUND_REQUESTED→REFUND_AUTHORIZED/CANCEL_REFUND_REQUEST; WRITE_OFF_REQUESTED→WRITE_OFF_AUTHORIZED/CANCEL_WRITE_OFF_REQUEST; others terminal or self-looping).

Entry point get_possible_transitions (caller: any with user context): returns transition_list from STATUS_TRANSITIONS; if REFUND_AUTHORIZED in list, checks RefundModel.requested_by == current user name—if same user (self-approval), removes first transition; if WRITE_OFF_AUTHORIZED in list, checks RoutingSlipModel.updated_by == current user name—if same user, removes first transition. Returns filtered or unfiltered transition_list.

Entry point validate_possible_transitions (caller: any): retrieves possible transitions via get_possible_transitions, throws BusinessException(Error.FAS_INVALID_RS_STATUS_CHANGE) if future_status not in allowed list.

Entry point get_actual_status (caller: any): maps custom status enum via RoutingSlipCustomStatus.from_key(status), returns custom.original_status if found, else returns status unchanged.

structured.condensed:
Factory and initialization module for the pay-queue service worker, which applies payments, receipts and account balance to the payment system.

The module exports `create_app(run_mode)`, called by the deployment entry point. It configures a Flask application in the specified `run_mode` (defaults to environment variable `DEPLOYMENT_ENV`, or 'production'). The app loads configuration from `config.CONFIGURATION[run_mode]`. If `SENTRY_DSN` is set in config, it initializes Sentry error tracking with `send_default_pii=False` and release tag `pay-queue@{version}`. It then initializes the GCP queue service, feature flags service, database, and endpoints via `register_endpoints(app)`. Finally it calls `build_cache(app)`.

`build_cache(app)` initializes the cache and clears it. When not in test mode (`TESTING` is False), it attempts to import `CodeService` from `pay_api.services.code` and calls `CodeService.build_all_codes_cache()` to populate the cache. If that call raises any exception, the error is logged but not re-raised; the app continues to start. The module defines no entry points or decision conditions beyond config-driven initialization.

structured.condensed: Decorator that protects a Flask route by verifying the caller holds a valid Google OAuth2 JWT token with claims matching configured constraints. Entry point: `ensure_authorized_queue_user` wraps a function and checks authorization on every call. Caller: any Flask route handler; no check shown in this chunk besides JWT verification. Incoming: JWT token in the Authorization header, split to extract the second element. Processing: calls `verify_jwt` which parses the token using Google's `id_token.verify_oauth2_token`, passing the audience from config key `PAY_AUDIENCE_SUB`. Decision: if `email_verified` claim is true AND `email` claim appears in the list at config key `VERIFY_PUBSUB_EMAILS`, verification passes (returns None); otherwise returns tuple ('Email not verified or does not match', 401). If any exception occurs during token parsing or verification, catches it, logs to Flask's logger at info level, and returns tuple ('Invalid token: {e}', 400). Outgoing: if verification fails, calls Flask's `abort(HTTPStatus.UNAUTHORIZED)` to halt the request. Token verification uses `CacheControl(Session())` to cache certificate fetches across requests. GOTCHA: exceptions are caught broadly and logged rather than re-raised; the caller sees 401 or 400 depending on failure mode, not the original exception.

Processes CGI EJV feedback files to update disbursement and payment status in the pay system.

Entry point: `reconcile_distributions(msg, is_feedback)` — called externally (no check shown) with `fileName` and `location` fields. Routes to `_update_acknowledgement` (logs only) or `_update_feedback`.

`_update_feedback` reads the file from Minio, groups batches, checks via `_is_processed_or_processing` whether the EJV batch has `feedback_file_ref` already set (stops if so; otherwise sets it and saves). Processes EJV feedback by parsing fixed-width lines: batch groups extract batch_number (positions 15:24), batch headers extract return_code (7:11) and message (11:161), journal/JV headers extract ejv_header_model_id from journal_name[2:], then disbursement_status_code and message. Sets `ejv_file.disbursement_status_code` and `ejv_header.disbursement_status_code` via `_get_disbursement_status`, flags has_errors if status is ERRORED. When file_type is PAYMENT, calls `_create_payment_record` with amount (42:57) and receipt_number (0:42). JV details routed to `_process_jv_details_feedback`. Commits db.session once. If has_errors and not DISABLE_EJV_ERROR_EMAIL, publishes mailer event.

GOTCHA: No transactional safeguard shown; partial parse failure leaves `feedback_file_ref` set but processing incomplete. GOTCHA: `receipt_number` is set in JH block but used only if present—undefined if JD blocks appear before JH.

structured.condensed: Processes payment and accounts payable (AP) feedback from EJV (Electronic Journal Voucher) files: parses fixed-width feedback records, links them to invoices and EJV headers, applies return codes to update disbursement and payment statuses, and creates receipts and payment records in the database. Input: file content lines with position-based field extraction. Main flow for JV details: extract invoice ID from line[205:315], look up invoice and EjvLink by header ID and invoice ID, read return code from line[315:319]; if Credit+Disbursement file and return code is non-zero, set invoice/link status to ERRORED and mark debit distribution's credit distribution stop_ejv=true; if Debit+Payment file and ERRORED, cancel invoice reference and set account's distribution code stop_ejv=true; if Debit+Payment and COMPLETED and not reversal, create or increment receipt. AP feedback flow: group file into batches (GABG/GIBG/APBG to BT), process each line—if BG extract batch_number and find EjvFile, if BH read return code and update file status, if IH delegate to _process_ap_header_routing_slips (for REFUND) or _process_ap_header_non_gov_disbursement (other). Helper: _fix_invoice_line patches CAS feedback by shifting line[300:315] if it contains '0'. Entry point _process_jv_details_feedback receives ejv_file, has_errors, line, receipt_number and returns bool; this chunk shows no check. Calls _get_disbursement_status(return_code) to map '0000' to COMPLETED, else ERRORED; _update_invoice_disbursement_status and _set_invoice_jv_reversal to update invoice timestamps and status fields; ReceiptModel.flush() to save receipt before return. Entry point _process_ap_feedback receives group_batches and returns bool; calls db.session.commit() after processing. GOTCHA: no check on caller identity for either entry point. GOTCHA: ReceiptModel.flush() does not commit; batch fails silently if database error occurs after flush but before the final commit in _process_ap_feedback.

structured.condensed:
Base class for EFT (Electronic Funds Transfer) file record parsing per TDI17 specification. Defines structure for records with three types (1=header, 2=detail, 7=trailer), each with fixed-width fields per specification.

Entry point: `__init__(content: str, index: int)` instantiates a record; this chunk shows no check.

Main flow: `is_valid_length()` checks content length against `EFTConstants.EXPECTED_LINE_LENGTH`; `validate_record_type(expected_record_type: str)` compares `record_type` to expected value and calls `add_error()` if mismatched; extraction via `extract_value(start_index: int, end_index: int)` strips whitespace from substring.

Parsing methods (`parse_decimal()`, `parse_int()`, `parse_date()`, `parse_datetime()`) attempt conversion, return None on failure, and call `add_error(error: EFTParseError)`. The `parse_decimal()` method handles trailing minus sign (value ending with '-' is converted to '-' prefix). All parsing attaches error details via `EFTParseError(error, index)` then appends to `errors` list. `has_errors()` returns true if errors list is non-empty; `get_error_messages()` returns string array of error messages.

GOTCHA: `parse_decimal()`, `parse_int()`, `parse_date()`, `parse_datetime()` return None silently on parse failure but add no index parameter to `EFTParseError` at call site—`add_error()` then sets it after creation, meaning errors are added even when method returns None.

structured.condensed:
Processes electronic fund transfer (EFT) file reconciliation: parses EFT file headers and trailers, validates them, credits shortnames for transactions, applies pending credits to linked accounts, and finalizes file and transaction statuses.

**Entry points:** `_apply_eft_pending_payments(context, shortname_balance)` - called by EFT reconciliation job (no check shown); `_finalize_process_state(eft_file_model)` - called by job completion (no check shown); `_process_eft_header(eft_header, eft_file_model)` - validates EFT file header; `_process_eft_trailer(eft_trailer, eft_file_model)` - validates EFT file trailer; `_process_eft_credits(shortname_balance, eft_file_id)` - credits shortnames from transactions.

**Apply pending payments flow:** Iterates shortnames; retrieves EFT short name and credit balance; gets linked accounts via EFTShortnamesService; skips links with unexpected pending payments (logs error via context.eft_error_handling); applies credits when amount_owing > 0 and ≤ credit_balance via EFTShortnamesService.process_payment_action with action=APPLY_CREDITS. On exception, logs error; service handles commit/rollback.

**Credit shortnames flow:** Iterates shortnames and transactions; queries existing EFTCreditModel by (eft_file_id, short_name_id, eft_transaction_id); skips zero/negative deposit_amount; creates or updates EFTCreditModel with deposit_amount as amount and remaining_amount; calls EFTHistoryService.create_funds_received; flushes to DB. On exception, sets has_credit_errors flag, logs, captures to Sentry.

**Header/trailer validation:** Returns False if header/trailer is None (logs error); sets file metadata via _set_eft_header_on_file/_set_eft_trailer_on_file; if has_errors() is True, saves error record via _save_eft_header_error/_save_eft_trailer_error and returns False.

**Finalization:** Updates transactions to COMPLETE status via _update_transactions_to_complete; sets EFTFileModel.status_code=COMPLETED, completed_on=now(), saves to DB.

**Database writes:** EFTCreditModel.flush() (not saved, partial update); EFTTransactionModel.save() for errors; EFTFileModel.save(); no duplicate guard on credit creation per transaction; exception in _process_eft_credits only logged and flagged, not re-raised.

structured.condensed:
EFT transaction processing: saves transaction details from parsed EFT records to database, tracks processing status, and filters transactions by location and type.

**Entry points (no checks shown):** `_save_eft_transaction` receives an EFTRecord, EFTFileModel, and is_error flag; `_update_transactions_to_fail` and `_update_transactions_to_complete` receive an EFTFileModel; `_filter_eft_transactions` and `_shortname_balance_as_dict` receive transaction lists.

**Main flow in `_save_eft_transaction`:** queries for existing EFTTransactionModel by file_id, line_number, and line_type (TRANSACTION); creates new if not found. If eft_record has transaction_description and short_name_type, calls `_get_shortname` to retrieve or create EFTShortnameModel and sets short_name_id. Sets line_type, line_number, file_id, status_code to FAILED or IN_PROGRESS based on is_error flag, error_messages from eft_record.get_error_messages(), batch_number, sequence_number, jv_type, jv_number via getattr with None default, deposit_date from deposit_datetime, transaction_date, and deposit_amount_cents (in cents). Saves model and assigns generated id back to eft_record.

**`_update_transactions_to_fail`:** queries EFTTransactionModel by file_id and line_type=TRANSACTION, bulk updates status_code to FAILED with synchronize_session='fetch', sets eft_file_model.status_code to FAILED and saves it, returns count updated.

**`_update_transactions_to_complete`:** queries by file_id and status_code=IN_PROGRESS, bulk updates status_code to COMPLETED, commits session, returns count.

**`_get_shortname`:** queries EFTShortnameModel by short_name and type; if not found, creates new model, sets short_name and type, saves, returns model.

**`_shortname_balance_as_dict`:** iterates EFTRecords, skips those with has_errors()=true. For each, extracts transaction_description (short_name), short_name_type, divides deposit_amount_cad by 100, builds dict keyed by short_name with nested balance, short_name_type, and transactions list containing {id, deposit_amount}.

**`_filter_eft_transactions`:** filters EFTRecords: keeps those with has_errors()=true OR (short_name_type in [EFT, WIRE] AND location_id matches eft_location_id parameter).

**Database writes:** EFTTransactionModel.save() creates or updates; EFTShortnameModel.save() creates; EFTFileModel.save() updates; bulk updates via db.session.update with synchronize_session='fetch'.

**GOTCHA:** `_update_transactions_to_complete` commits session but `_save_eft_transaction` does not—inconsistent transaction handling. `_update_transactions_to_fail` does not commit. Deposit amount stored as integer cents but divided by 100 as float in `_shortname_balance_as_dict`—type mismatch risk. Shortname lookup in `_save_eft_transaction` happens only if both transaction_description and short_name_type are truthy; partial updates possible.

structured.condensed:
Reconciles payment settlement records from a CSV file against invoices in the pay system, creating or updating payment records in the database.

Reads CSV rows keyed by source transaction number, each containing target invoice number, amount, date, and status. Groups rows by source transaction to handle different settlement types: PAD/PADR/PAYR (one payment per row, status COMPLETED if target status is PAID, else FAILED; paid amount is app amount for COMPLETED or calculated from outstanding for PARTIAL), BOLP (online banking: sums amounts across rows, status always COMPLETED, publishes mailer events), EFTP (marks existing payment by receipt number as COMPLETED). Saves payment before commit with: payment_date, invoice_number, invoice_amount, paid_amount, payment_method, payment_status_code, receipt_number, and payment_account_id looked up from row.

Two calls check for existing payment by invoice_number and status to skip duplicates: _get_payment_by_inv_number_and_status returns COMPLETED if found (exits early to avoid duplicate), or returns latest FAILED if creating a FAILED payment and no COMPLETED exists. For COMPLETED status with existing payment, returns without saving. Queries commit once at end of all records.

Entry point _create_payment_records takes CSV as string (no check shown); called as job/handler (caller elsewhere). Calls out: PaymentSystemFactory.create_from_payment_method to get payment service; db.session.query, db.session.add, db.session.commit on PaymentModel table; _publish_online_banking_mailer_events with payment rows and amount. No retry, no failure recording shown beyond commit.

GOTCHA: no duplicate guard on invoice_number for PAD payments; BOLP sums multiple rows with no deduplication check; COMPLETED payment lookup returns immediately without checking if being re-processed; payment saved and committed even if downstream mailer event publish fails.

structured.condensed:
Publishes payment events to queues for mailer and account notifications.

`_publish_mailer_events` sends a message to the ACCOUNT_MAILER_TOPIC queue with a QueueMessage containing source=PAY_QUEUE, the supplied message_type, a payload created from pay_account and row via `_create_event_payload`, and the topic from config. This chunk shows no check on who may call it. On exception, logs error and warning with the auth_account_id and payload, then sends an error message to Sentry via `capture_message`; no retry.

`_publish_online_banking_mailer_events` receives rows (all for the same account) and a paid_amount. It extracts the payment account from the first row, then filters rows by TARGET_TXN == RECEIPT (credit_rows) and TARGET_TXN_STATUS == "partial" (under_pay_rows). If credit_rows exist, sets message_type to ONLINE_BANKING_OVER_PAYMENT and sums credit_amount from APP_AMOUNT fields; else if under_pay_rows exist, sets ONLINE_BANKING_UNDER_PAYMENT; else ONLINE_BANKING_PAYMENT. Publishes to ACCOUNT_MAILER_TOPIC with payload containing accountId (auth_account_id), paymentMethod=ONLINE_BANKING, amount and creditAmount (formatted to 2 decimals). On exception, logs and sends error to Sentry; no retry.

`_publish_account_events` publishes to AUTH_EVENT_TOPIC with the supplied message_type and payload from `_create_event_payload`. On exception, logs and sends error to Sentry; no retry.

`_create_event_payload` returns a dict with accountId, paymentMethod (converted via `_convert_payment_method`), outstandingAmount, originalAmount, amount—all extracted from the row by Column keys.

`_convert_payment_method` maps SourceTransaction.ONLINE_BANKING to PaymentMethod.ONLINE_BANKING, SourceTransaction.PAD to PaymentMethod.PAD, else returns the SourceTransaction enum value.

`_get_row_value` looks up row[key.value.lower()].

`_create_nsf_invoice` creates an invoice for NSF fees: finds the fee schedule for corp_type='BCR', filing_type='NSF'; creates an invoice with status CREATED, total=fee_schedule.fee.amount, paid=0, payment_method=CC; saves it; calls `NonSufficientFundsService.save_non_sufficient_funds` with the invoice_id, invoice_number, cfs_account, and reason_description; creates a PaymentLineItemModel with that invoice_id and an active status; creates an InvoiceReferenceModel with status ACTIVE; returns the saved invoice. No duplicate guard on invoice creation.

`_get_settlement_type` iterates payment_lines, returning the RECORD_TYPE of the first row matching BOLP, EFTP, PAD, PADR, or PAYR; else returns None.

`_create_cas_settlement` creates a CasSettlementModel with file_name, received_on=now, saves and returns it.

GOTCHA: `_publish_mailer_events`, `_publish_online_banking_mailer_events`, and `_publish_account_events` catch all exceptions but only log and notify Sentry; no retry on transient failures.

Applies legacy COLIN corporate filings to the legal-database models: updates business, filing and related records, then notifies the account service. Entry points `corps_filer.process_filing` (incorporationApplication, annualReport, dissolution, putBackOn, correction) and `filer.process_filing` (registration, conversion, changeOfRegistration, dissolution, putBackOn, correction) each take `(config, filing_id, event_filing_data_dict, filing_data, db)`, load Filing and FilingCore by filing_id (raise Exception if core missing), dispatch to per-type processors returning `(business, filing_rec, filing_meta)`, set transaction_id/status COMPLETED/colin_event_id, commit. Post-commit, if `config.UPDATE_ENTITY` true: incorporation/registration create business_id and call create_affiliation, update_affiliation, post_process; dissolution/putBackOn call update_entity with state HISTORICAL/ACTIVE. Idempotency: return if status already COMPLETED. Annual_report bumps last_ar_year; conversion routes on business.legal_type; correction links parent filing, adds comments, or sets PENDING_CORRECTION for review. Update_offices/update_parties/update_share_structure delete existing rows then recreate, returning error codes. Update_aliases full-replace. Update_business_profile handles 200/201 as success, 400 DATA_ALREADY_EXISTS retries with PUT.

GOTCHA: Commit before AccountService calls—if those fail, filing persists COMPLETED with no external update or retry. Delete-then-recreate can leave business without offices/parties/shares; shares delete failure returns early with no new shares. Errors from update_offices/update_parties/update_share_structure recorded only in list, not retried. Many processors swallow errors silently (suppress IndexError/KeyError/TypeError, print only) so filings marked COMPLETED may have partial data. Bare except in delete steps hides root cause. No permission check shown. Not transactional.

structured.condensed: Deployment-only PostgreSQL 10 database instance (no custom logic) that stores payment data for Payment API, which owns the schema. The instance runs on OpenShift as a ReplicatedStatefulSet: ClusterIP service on 5432, PersistentVolumeClaim for data storage, credentials via ConfigMap and Secret, auto-triggered redeployment on ImageChange or ConfigChange. Recreate strategy incurs downtime. Liveness probe checks TCP 5432; readiness probe runs `psql` as `$POSTGRESQL_USER`. Two manual SQL scripts generate and delete performance-test data: the load script creates 100,000 iterations of `payment_accounts`, `cfs_accounts`, `invoices`, `invoice_references`, and `payment_line_items` under auth_account_id 2062; cleanup cascades deletes by the same hardcoded ID and name pattern `%PERFORMANCE-TEST%`. GOTCHA: the load script's single auth_account_id can trigger a `one_or_none` exception in Payment API if run on a shared DB. GOTCHA: cleanup has no transaction guard and will delete any real data under ID 2062. GOTCHA: template parameter description says "basee64 encoded" (garbled); verify Secret credential usage.

Save step: set `filing.transaction_id = transaction.id`, call `filing.set_processed()`, `db.session.add(business, filing)`, `db.session.commit()`. Display-only Vue components for a business dashboard: renders contextual alert panels in priority order (in-dissolution, amalgamation, disable-non-benevolent-corps, frozen-information, missing-information, not-in-compliance, not-in-good-standing) and a dismissible legal-obligation card, both driven by store state flags. No API calls or persistence.

Alerts.vue builds alert list from seven boolean flags in `useBusinessStore`; computed `alerts` maps flags to components, `togglePanel(index)` opens/closes panels (storing open state as index; NaN when closed), and emits `count` on mount and change. InDissolution and Amalgamation extract and format warning dates from store data: Amalgamation finds type `WarningTypes.FUTURE_EFFECTIVE_AMALGAMATION` and formats with `DateUtilities.apiToPacificDate`; InDissolution finds type containing `WarningTypes.INVOLUNTARY_DISSOLUTION`, reads `data.targetDissolutionDate`, converts via `yyyyMmDdToDate` then `dateToPacificDate`, showing 'Unknown' if missing. FrozenInformation and MissingInformation conditionally hide phone numbers: `hidePhoneNumbers = isEntityFirm && !GetFeatureFlag('show-alert-phone-numbers-firm')`, passed as `hidePhoneTollFree`/`hidePhoneVictoria` (FrozenInformation) or `hidePhoneNumbers` (MissingInformation) to shared `ContactInfo` child. CorporateOnline builds description via `GetCorpFullDescription(getLegalType)` and links to `getCorporateOnlineUrl` in new tab. LegalObligation renders only when `showLegalObligation && getObligations && isBusinessWithNoMaintenanceFilings && isBusiness` (where `isBusiness` checks `sessionStorage.BUSINESS_ID`); watcher `@Watch('isActive', {immediate: true})` sets `showLegalObligation` on mount and change; dismiss button sets it false locally (unpersisted); "Read more" toggles detail section. No permission checks shown. Panel header disables pointer events; only details button allows toggle.

GOTCHA: New alert types must be added to Alerts.vue computed property or they never appear and are not counted. GOTCHA: Panel open state stored as index; if alert list changes while open, index may point to wrong alert. GOTCHA: Amalgamation and InDissolution read warning data without guards; missing warning or date could produce wrong/empty result (only InDissolution has 'Unknown' fallback).

Unit tests and golden fixtures for the PDF report path of `GET /api/v1/businesses/{identifier}/filings` and `.../filings/{filing.id}`. Tests mock the outbound POST to the report service and compare sent JSON against snapshots.

**In:** GET with `accept: application/pdf` and role BASIC_USER or STAFF_ROLE (via `create_header`).

**Out:** POST to `REPORT_SVC_URL/` with `Content-Type: application/json`. Body carries filing data (`filing.header`, `business`, filing sections), `templateVars` (environment, meta_title, meta_subject, source='LEAR', effective_date, filing_date_time), and `reportName` as `{identifier}_{date}_{time}_{Report}_Filing.pdf`.

**Flow:** For multiple filings with PDF accept header, return 406 NOT_ACCEPTABLE with message "Cannot return a single PDF of multiple filing submissions." For unknown filing type, return 404 NOT_FOUND "Available on paper only." For single filing, POST to report service. Test is parametrized by role and filing type (ANNUAL_REPORT, COA, COD, INCORPORATION_APPLICATION with addressCountry='CA', nrNumber='NR 1234567').

structured.condensed:
Test code pinning the behaviour of the legal-api service layer (authorization, digital_credentials, flags, involuntary_dissolution, mras, queue, registration_bootstrap, AccountService) with mocked or local auth service, MRAS, NATS and LaunchDarkly; includes Docker Compose files.

Authorization `authorized(identifier, jwt, action)` returns `False` if any argument is `None`, else calls `AUTH_SVC_URL` via HTTP GET with Bearer token. `get_allowed` and `get_allowed_filings` return FilingKey lists; `get_allowable_actions` returns filing links and types; `are_digital_credentials_allowed` and `is_self_registered_owner_operator` check user ownership.

JWTs are RS256 built with realm_access.roles, username, loginSource='IDIR'; STAFF_ROLE='staff'. Role gate: STAFF_ROLE and COLIN_SVC_ROLE with actions `['view','edit']` permit `edit`; BASIC_USER without matching identifier is denied; missing/invalid action denied. `add_comment` denied for CP0001237.

`get_allowed_filings` matrix depends on state, legal type, role and blockers: admin_freeze, standing, incomplete filings (BLOCKER_FILING_STATUSES: alteration, correction), pending dissolutions (BLOCKER_DISSOLUTION_STATUSES_FOR_AMALG), amalgamation, validStateFiling, completed prerequisites. `is_allowed` lets staff/basic users edit DRAFT, not PENDING. Resubmission allowed only for DRAFT and CHANGE_REQUESTED.

Digital credentials refused when: token absent; User.find_by_jwt_token returns None; login_source != 'BCSC'; roles include STAFF_ROLE; business is GP; SP not self-registered owner-operator. Owner-operator matching needs registration filing with matching proprietor name and completing parties; fails on middle initial mismatch.

`InvoluntaryDissolutionService._get_businesses_eligible_query()` excludes unexpired LIMITED_RESTORATION, XPRO from NWPTA, admin_freeze; orders by transition_overdue then ar_overdue; applies enable/disable flags via mocked AccountService.get_affiliations.

`Flags.is_on()` and `value()` read local Flag.json or LaunchDarkly when LD_SDK_KEY set; missing flags return `False`. User model: `find_by_jwt_token`, `create_from_jwt_token`, `get_or_create_user_by_jwt`; display_name strips IDIR prefix and suffix.

`QueueService` publishes `{'colinFiling': {'id': n}}` to durable subject `colin_queue` over NATS. MRAS.get_jurisdictions(identifier) returns `{id, name, nameFr, redirectUrl, targetProfileId}`, keeping only entries with TargetProfileID; returns None on non-OK status, [] when no jurisdictions found.

GOTCHA: create_from_jwt_token and get_or_create_user_by_jwt raise AttributeError on bytes tokens. GOTCHA: create_test_user defined twice; second shadows first. GOTCHA: test_flags_bool_missing_flag uses bare except swallowing errors. GOTCHA: test_allowed_filings_warnings sets SP/GP warnings but asserts nothing about effect. GOTCHA: No retry, re-raise or queue-publish failure handling shown. GOTCHA: test_registraion_bootstrap_service calls real auth service with account affiliation POST/DELETE expecting 200.

structured.condensed:
Flask/restplus blueprints exposing auth service REST API under `/api/v1`. Handlers authenticate via JWT, validate JSON against named schemas, and delegate to service layer (OrgService, UserService, InvitationService, AffiliationService, MembershipService, ProductService, AuthorizationService, KeycloakService). BusinessException converts to `{code, message}` with `exception.status_code`. Nothing is retried.

Entry points: 23 blueprints mounted by `V1Endpoint.init_app`; test routes (`/test`, reset) mount only when FLASK_ENV is development or testing, guarded by env check only. Handlers read `request.get_json()` and query params, return JSON plus HTTP status. Outbound calls go to service classes, MinioService for signed PUT URLs, KeycloakService only.

Role guards via `@_jwt.has_one_of_roles`: org routes (search, create, get, put, delete) each have role sets; contacts, affiliations, members and invitations take SYSTEM/STAFF_*/PUBLIC_USER sets; task requires STAFF; keycloak requires SYSTEM; activity_log allows SYSTEM/STAFF/ACCOUNT_HOLDER; entity POST/DELETE need SYSTEM; bcol_profiles allow STAFF_MANAGE_ACCOUNTS/PUBLIC_USER; org_products GET/POST/PATCH each have sets; org_api_keys POST is SYSTEM only, GET/DELETE allow STAFF_MANAGE_ACCOUNTS and ACCOUNT_HOLDER.

Decisions: product subscriptions call `create_product_subscription` then `update_org_product_keycloak_groups`; task review calls `update_task` then `update_org_product_keycloak_groups(account_id)` if type is PRODUCT, using `HTTP_ORIGIN` header; affiliation invitation PATCH `authorize_action` requires admin/coordinator via `_verify_permissions()`, routes `accept`/`refuse` to handlers or raises; PUT `/token/<token>` validates token then accepts; user POST `/bcros` validates token, creates anonymous user/membership, accepts invitation; document types swap by claims (TERMS_OF_USE→TERMS_OF_USE_DIRECTOR_SEARCH for anonymous, TERMS_OF_USE_GOVM for staff), PAD terms substitute today's date; org affiliation routes on `is_new_business`; entity `hasValidPassCode` true when unclaimed/non-null or corp type SP/GP; test reset (Role.TESTER) deletes user's rows, resets user, resets Keycloak OTP for BCEID.

Open routes: `GET /codes/<type>`, `/products`, `/meta/info`, `/ops/healthz`, `/ops/readyz`, `/documents/affidavit`, `GET /invitations/tokens/<token>`. JWT-only, no role check: entity GET, authentication, contacts, authorizations, user and org login routes. Entity `skip_auth=True` bypasses authorization but masks data. No duplicate guards on invitation or entity creation.

GOTCHA: keycloak.py sets 400 response when `role` missing but doesn't return it; try block runs with `None`. GOTCHA: user_settings.py returns 200 with `[]` on BusinessException, hiding failures. GOTCHA: user.py has malformed set-literal responses (`{'msg', status}`) on OTP/delete/patch errors so status never reaches caller. GOTCHA: org.py `patch_organization_member` reads membership before checking existence.

structured.condensed:
Renders business filings and documents into PDFs by building template variables and POSTing them to external report services, or fetching pre-built PDFs from storage. Three entry points serve reports, business documents, and dissolution notices via Gotenberg.

**Inputs & Outputs:**
- `get_pdf(filing, report_type=None)` returns PDF bytes or `{'message': 'Available on paper only.'}` (404) on `FileNotFoundError`.
- `Report.get_pdf()` dispatches on `report_type or filing.filing_type`: static reports fetch from Minio by `document.file_key`; others POST `{reportName, template (base64), templateVars}` to `REPORT_SVC_URL` with Bearer JWT auth and receive response.content or error JSON.
- `BusinessDocument.get_pdf()` and `get_json()` follow the same pattern; `get_json()` returns template data only.
- `report_v2.get_pdf()` POSTs multipart to `REPORT_API_GOTENBERG_URL/forms/chromium/convert/html` with Bearer Google ID token (if audience set), reportName/template/templateVars, and `index.html`, `header.html`, `footer.html` files; returns content or `None` (1800s timeout).

**Main Flow:**
1. `_format_filing_json()` dispatches on `_report_key` to per-type formatters (change of registration, correction, share classes, etc.).
2. Most formatters diff against prior completed filing via `VersionedBusinessDetailsService`, setting `changed`, `newParties`, `ceasedParties`, `partyChange`.
3. `_set_description()` picks `entityAct` by entity type (COOP, SP/GP, default).
4. `BusinessDocument._get_template_data()` branches on `_document_key`: `lseal`/`summary` add addresses/state changes; `summary` adds parties, translations, business/amalgamation/liquidation/continuation details; SP/GP fetch registration date. `get_json=True` trims `registrarInfo`; otherwise calls `_set_directors`/`_set_record_keepers` (custodians for HISTORICAL only).
5. `RegistrarInfo.get_registrar_info(date)` picks registrar from hardcoded list by date range, inlines signature PNG as base64.
6. `report_v2` handles DISSOLUTION only: title says CANCELLATION if `furnishing_name` contains XPRO; `_set_ep_registration()` keeps MRAS jurisdictions AB, SK, MB.
7. `_substitute_template_parts()` replaces `[[name.html]]` markers with part files (60+ static parts in `report.py`).

**Decisions:**
- `ReportMeta.reports` maps filing types to description/filename; `hasDifferentTemplates` types pick filename by entity type.
- Unmatched `_report_key` falls back to `_set_addresses()`/`_set_directors()` under `suppress(KeyError)`.
- `BusinessDocument` branches on `_document_key` (lseal, summary, cogs, cstat).

**Entry Points:** No caller authorization check appears. Template load errors in `report.py`/`business_document.py` are logged and re-raised; `report_v2.py` logs and continues with unsubstituted template.

**No retry, no writes.**

GOTCHA: `report_v2.get_pdf()` returns `None` on non-200 response without logging/raising—failed furnishing render goes unnoticed. `_format_address()` uses `pycountry.countries.search_fuzzy()[0]`, raises on invalid `addressCountry`. Nested filing lookups lack `KeyError` handling; `suppress(KeyError)` silently drops data. `_format_share_class_data` does `del share_class['id']` and mutates source objects in place. `LegislationDatetime.is_future()` compares ISO string with naive `utcnow()`. `format_as_report_string` uses `%-d`.

structured.condensed:
Unit-test layer for filing UI components (ConsentContinuationOut, HeaderActions, AllowableActions) and JSON fixtures mocking Legal API filing-list responses. Tests pin down component behaviour and fixture structures. All external calls (axios, LegalServices, feature flags, window.location.assign) are mocked.

**Inputs:** Filing payload with filingTypeCode CONTO, entityType CP, consentContinuationOut.details, certifiedBy, routingSlipNumber, priority, foreignJurisdiction {country, region}. Ledger fixtures define businessIdentifier, filingId, name, status, submitter, submittedDate, effectiveDate, paymentStatusCode, commentsCount and type-specific data (orderDetails for consent, correctionFilingId for corrections, filingSubType for amalgamations).

**Outputs:** filingId 456 on save; payment redirect to `https://auth.web.url/makepayment/{paymentToken}/{encodedCallbackURL}?accountid={accountId}` (accountId from sessionStorage CURRENT_ACCOUNT); consentContinuationOut ledger panel shows "FILED AND PAID", "EFFECTIVE", "View Documents" button; expiry formatted as "August 17, 2023 at 11:59 pm Pacific time".

**isPageValid (staff):** true only when certifyFormValid, courtOrderValid, documentDeliveryValid and foreignJurisdictionValid all true. **isPayRequired:** false if totalFee is 0, true otherwise. **Draft resume:** sets certifiedBy, staffPaymentData.option=1 (FAS), routingSlipNumber, isPriority, draftCountry, draftRegion. **File & Pay button:** after validation and totalFee=350, redirects via window.location.assign to payURL.

Enums are imported by components, stores and mixins; filing-related enum values must match the Legal API. GOTCHA: `FilingSubTypes` dissolution constants DISS_D1A through DISS_HDV are commented-out and not defined; code needing them will fail. GOTCHA: `getNrState` checks consent before not-approved, so state mapping depends on check order; `isNrInvalid` does not call `getNrState`, so an NR mapping to NOT_APPROVED can pass validation. GOTCHA: enum values are string matches with Legal API; renaming silently breaks API contracts.

structured.condensed: Scheduled batch job that finds businesses due for annual report (AR) reminders and publishes them to an emailer service. Invoked by job scheduler with optional `outstanding-bcomps` argument; reads businesses from legal Postgres DB via `legal_api`, checks a LaunchDarkly flag, and selects flow accordingly. In `find_and_send_ar_reminder()`: filters businesses by legal type (BCOMP, BCOMP_CONTINUE_IN, CONTINUE_IN, ULC_CONTINUE_IN, CCC_CONTINUE_IN; adds COMP, BC_CCC, BC_ULC_COMPANY if `enable-bc-ccc-ulc` flag on), requires `send_ar_ind=True`, state ACTIVE, null `restoration_expiry_date`, and AR due. In `send_outstanding_bcomps_ar_reminder()`: same types, but only those with `last_ar_date` ≥ 1 year old. Per-business: fetches `arFee` via `GET {PAYMENT_SVC_FEES_URL}/{legal_type}/{filing_type_code}` with Bearer token from account service; publishes `{email: {businessId, type: "annualReport", option: "reminder", arFee, arYear}}` to NATS subject `entity.email`; sets and saves `business.last_ar_reminder_year`. Exceptions in `send_email` go to Sentry at error level; exceptions in `find_and_send_ar_reminder` are logged only. Each business committed inside loop as processed. No entry guards shown. GOTCHA: fee request has no timeout, risking job hang. GOTCHA: mid-loop failure leaves earlier businesses saved and notified; rest silently skipped. GOTCHA: `legal_api` unpinned (bcgov/lear repo), rebuilds pick up model changes. GOTCHA: `ProdConfig` generates random `SECRET_KEY` if env unset, prints warning to stderr.

structured.condensed:
A one-shot scheduled job that finds filings whose effective date has arrived and enqueues each onto the entity filer's NATS queue via the Legal API and account service.

**Flow:** `config.get_named_config(name='production')` selects config class (ProdConfig for production/staging/default, TestConfig for testing, DevConfig for dev; unknown name raises KeyError). `get_bearer_token(app, timeout)` POSTs to `ACCOUNT_SVC_AUTH_URL` with Basic auth of `(ACCOUNT_SVC_CLIENT_ID, ACCOUNT_SVC_CLIENT_SECRET)` and `grant_type=client_credentials`; returns None on exception. `get_filing_ids(app)` GETs `LEGAL_API_URL/internal/filings/future_effective` with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header; raises bare Exception on non-200 status. For each filing id, `ServiceWorker.publish()` sends `{'filing': {'id': filing_id}}` to NATS subject `NATS_FILER_SUBJECT` (servers and cluster from `NATS_SERVERS`, `NATS_CLUSTER_ID`). `run()` wraps flow in try/except; errors logged, not re-raised. ProdConfig generates random `SECRET_KEY` if unset, warns to stderr.

**Entry point:** `__main__` in `file_future_effective.py`. No guard or permission check shown. No idempotency guard, no duplicate detection, nothing records enqueued ids. Nothing committed before steps that can fail. Bearer token returns None on exception, next call sends "Bearer None", hiding real error. If job re-runs before filer processes, filing may file twice. Exception swallowing means process may exit 0 after failure; scheduler sees no failure.

**GOTCHA:** Filename mismatch: `k8s/templates/bc.yaml` CMD runs `future_effective_filings.py` but script is `file_future_effective.py`; built image may fail to start. No retry on account or Legal API calls. No exit-code handling in `run.sh`.

structured.condensed:
A GCP Pub/Sub push-subscriber service that consumes CloudEvents from a queue and sends emails via `notification_service.send_email`.

**In:** HTTP POST to `/` receives a Pub/Sub push envelope with base64-encoded CloudEvent containing `id`, `source` ('account-mailer'), `type` (a `QueueMessageTypes` value), `data` (mail details) and `time`. Handler must return 200.

**Out:** Calls `notification_service.send_email(payload)` with `recipients` (from message, org admin contact, or configured contact), `content.subject` (`SubjectType` value), `content.body`, and `attachments` (None in tested cases).

**Main flow:** Receive Pub/Sub push → extract and decode CloudEvent → route by `QueueMessageTypes` → call `send_email` with routed template, subject and recipients.

**Decisions:** (1) Duplicate detection by CloudEvent `id` — if seen before, skip `send_email` call. (2) Message routing — `QueueMessageTypes` determines template, subject and recipients; routing code not shown. (3) Auth on push endpoint — tests mock `gcp_queue.gcp_auth.verify_jwt` to return `''`, implying JWT verification exists but not shown.

**Message types tested:** Account/membership (ADMIN_REMOVED, TEAM_MEMBER_INVITED, RESET_PASSCODE); payment/PAD/online banking (PAD_INVOICE_CREATED, PAD_SETUP_FAILED, ONLINE_BANKING_UNDER_PAYMENT, ONLINE_BANKING_OVER_PAYMENT, ONLINE_BANKING_PAYMENT, PAYMENT_PENDING); statements/reminders (STATEMENT_NOTIFICATION, PAYMENT_REMINDER_NOTIFICATION, PAYMENT_DUE_NOTIFICATION); account locking/refunds (NSF_LOCK_ACCOUNT, NSF_UNLOCK_ACCOUNT, CONFIRMATION_PERIOD_OVER, REFUND_DRAWDOWN_REQUEST); EJV_FAILED (file uploaded to Minio bucket `cgi-ejv` first).

**Entry point:** `app.py` calls `create_app()`, runs on `PORT` (default 5002) or via Dockerfile gunicorn on 8080. DeploymentConfig exposes 8080, probes `/readyz` and `/healthz` on 7070.

**Dependencies:** Keycloak, Minio, LaunchDarkly, Sentry, gcp-queue; auth-api models/services installed from git. Vaults: shared, keycloak, minio, relationship, sentry, launchdarkly, gcp-queue.

structured.condensed:
Vue frontend for business filings, entity header/menu, and dashboard in BC Registries. Views read `filingId` from `$route.query` (0 for new, >0 for draft); load drafts via `LegalServices.fetchFiling('businesses/{identifier}/filings/{filingId}')` and save through `createFiling` or `updateFiling(identifier, filing, filingId, isDraft)`. Filing body contains `header` (name, certifiedBy, email, date, FilingTypes.*), `business` (foundingDate, identifier, legalName, legalType), and filing-specific block (annualReport, changeOfDirectors, etc.). Staff payment adds routingSlipNumber (FAS), bcolAccountNumber/datNumber/folioNumber (BCOL), or waiveFees (NO_FEE). Fee codes push through `updateFilingData(...)` to `SbcFeeSummary` returning `totalFee`. On success with `isPaymentActionRequired`, navigates to `getAuthWebUrl + 'makepayment/' + paymentToken + '/' + returnUrl`; otherwise to dashboard. `AmalgamationSelection.vue` calls `createBusinessAA(type)` → `LegalServices.createDraftBusiness(...)` with `amalgamationApplication` draft, routes to `amalg-short-information` or `amalg-reg-information?id=businessId`, throws 'Invalid business identifier' if no identifier. `Signin.vue` redirects to `getLoginUrl?return=<encoded sessionStorage BASE_URL>`; `Signout.vue` wraps SbcSignout.

`isPageValid` gates File and Pay, combining per-section flags. `isPayRequired` is `totalFee > 0`. Staff detour: `onClickFilePay` opens Staff Payment dialog when `isRoleStaff && !fromStaffPayment` (AnnualReport, ConsentAmalgamationOut, ConsentContinuationOut, StandaloneDirectorsFiling, StandaloneOfficeAddressFiling). `busySaving` blocks double clicks. `saveFiling(isDraft)` builds filing; errors store `response.data.errors`/`warnings` in `saveErrors`/`saveWarnings` then re-raise. 402 clears `haveChanges`, opens `paymentErrorDialog`, keeps filing; `onPaymentErrorDialogExit` goes to dashboard unless `isRoleStaff`. Other errors set `saveErrorReason` (SAVE, SAVE_RESUME, FILE_PAY); dialogs retry or finish. `goToDashboard(force)` shows 'Unsaved Changes' confirm when `haveChanges` true. Draft restore checks filing type, status DRAFT, matching identifier; failure opens `resumeErrorDialog`. Staff-only views throw if `!isRoleStaff`. AGM Extension prevents draft resume (filingId !== 0). AGM Location Change limits year to currentYear−2…+1, location to 400 chars. AnnualReport.mounted validates identifier, year, filingId; requires `arMinDate`/`arMaxDate` (coop) or `nextARDate` (BC); failure calls `goToDashboard(true)`. AnnualReport.allowChange checks AGM date. EntityMenu: change-business-info and dissolve return false when `!isGoodStanding && !isRoleStaff`, else disabled unless `isAllowed(...)` passes; filtered by feature flags and entity type. DigitalCredentials.mounted redirects unless `isAllowed(DIGITAL_CREDENTIALS)`. Dashboard buttons disabled by `isAllowed(ADDRESS_CHANGE)` and `isAllowed(DIRECTOR_CHANGE)`. `onAddressChangeClick` branches on firm (edit), base company (COA warning), or other (standalone).

GOTCHA: pay-URL `navigate()` unguarded; failure strands user; 402 sets `haveChanges=false` unconditionally. GOTCHA: EntityMenu references commented-out `isEntityCoop` and `isEntityFirm` getters; may fail at runtime. GOTCHA: client-side role checks (created throwing, mounted redirect) only gate shown; no server-side check appears. GOTCHA: `window.onbeforeunload` overwritten without saving previous handler. GOTCHA: `StandaloneOfficeAddressFiling` hardcodes `email: 'no_one@never.get'`.

structured.condensed: This is a pytest suite for legal-api v2 REST resources and models, testing endpoints through Flask test client with mocked auth service, NameX, report service, NATS, entity events, MRAS and digital credentials. It checks status codes, JSON shape and database state. Every request uses `create_header(jwt, [role], identifier)` with roles from `UserRoles`. Role handling on business sub-resources: PUBLIC_USER/ACCOUNT_IDENTITY calls AUTH_SVC_URL/entities/{identifier}/authorizations; empty roles return 401; STAFF_ROLE/SYSTEM_ROLE skip that call. Endpoints include business sub-resources (addresses, aliases, comments, directors, documents, parties, resolutions, share-classes, tasks, filings, furnishings, digitalCredentials), webhooks for connections and credentials, business search (SYSTEM_ROLE only; returns 401 for STAFF_ROLE), COLIN sync (GET lists filings with no colin_event_ids; PATCH sets ids), internal routes (needs SYSTEM_ROLE), MRAS (system role only, else 401), NAICS search and lookup, documents endpoint. Admin configurations (GET/PUT need STAFF_ROLE, else 401): query `?names=` split/stripped/uppercased; PUT validates string values, schedule cron format, integer positivity; rejects duplicates/empty with 400. Admin reviews (staff only): POST saves CHANGE_REQUESTED/APPROVED/REJECTED; comment required for CHANGE_REQUESTED/REJECTED; creates ReviewResult, maps status to Filing.status, publishes NATS_EMAILER_SUBJECT and NATS_FILER_SUBJECT (approved only); already-decided returns 400; unknown id returns 404. Request tracker: GET needs bn_edit; POST resubmit creates row with is_admin=true and message_id. Business GET: missing returns 404; `allowed_filings=true` adds allowedFilings; SP/GP with missing info add MISSING_REQUIRED_BUSINESS_INFO to complianceWarnings; hasCourtOrders set when exist; draft amalgamation name from NR, legal_name, or "Numbered Limited Company". Business POST: takes `draft=true` or `only_validate=true`; valid filings: incorporationApplication, registration, amalgamationApplication, continuationIn; empty filing 400; draft returns 201. Tasks: `construct_task_list` per legal type; conversion task (status NEW) only for SP/GP with missing business info; PENDING_CORRECTION filing in list. COLIN corrections: if has colin_id, return correction filing; else corrected filing. NAICS: search_term required, minimum 3 chars (400); invalid format 400; unknown code 404; results include NAICS_YEAR and NAICS_VERSION from config. GOTCHA: no duplicate guard on comments shown; STAFF_ROLE required for comment POST, else 401. GOTCHA: test_get_share_classes_unauthorized actually tests resolutions despite its name. GOTCHA: production code location for auth-service bypass in STAFF/SYSTEM not shown.

Alembic migrations that evolve the Postgres schema for EFT and Wire payments in pay-api: file processing, short names, credits, GL transfers, refunds, and activity ledgers. They only alter the database schema; they take no requests and call no queues or services except one Keycloak backfill in `8eac44955fb6`.

Key changes: `29867cf1bd9e` moves account linking from `eft_short_names.auth_account_id` into `eft_short_name_links` (status 'LINKED', version 1). `4b3bd37727a5` and `4e57f6cf649c` backfill `eft_credit_invoice_links.status_code` to 'PENDING' then enforce NOT NULL. `423a9f909079` adds `type` ('EFT' or Wire) to short names and enforces it. `4e57f6cf649c` makes `eft_refunds.comment` NOT NULL, widens `ejv_links.link_type` to String(50), changes `refunds_partial.disbursement_date` from Date to DateTime. `e64c153e63ae` drops `payment_account_id` from `eft_credits`; account derived via links. `75a39e02c746` renames `eft_refunds.updated_by_name` to `updated_name` and shrinks `updated_by` to 50 chars. `eft_refund_email_list` created (`f921d5e32835`), rebuilt twice, dropped (`87a09ba91c0d`).

`8eac44955fb6` calls Keycloak if invoice or payment rows exist: POSTs to `JWT_OIDC_ISSUER/protocol/openid-connect/token` with basic auth (KEYCLOAK_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_ID, KEYCLOAK_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_SECRET), then GETs `/auth/admin/.../users?max=999999999` with bearer token, running four UPDATEs per user matching lowercase username to `created_by` and `updated_by`. Keycloak failure aborts; no retry. Several migrations set `statement_timeout` to 20000 ms for large table alters.

GOTCHA: `8eac44955fb6` builds UPDATE SQL by string interpolation of Keycloak display names with no escaping—a quote in a name breaks the statement or injects SQL. GOTCHA: `4e57f6cf649c` and `f9c15c7f29f5` drop and recreate `eft_refund_email_list`, losing rows; downgrade of `87a09ba91c0d` does not restore it. GOTCHA: `29867cf1bd9e` downgrade uses unordered scalar subqueries; a short name with multiple links yields nondeterministic results.

uses.name: Keycloak
uses.what: GET /auth/admin/.../users?max=999999999 with bearer token; returns user list with display names matched to created_by/updated_by; failure aborts migration with no retry.

structured.condensed: TypeScript type definitions for the business-filing UI. It defines the shapes of Legal API responses (filing entries, tasks, business records, name requests), filings the UI sends (amalgamation, correction, dissolution, restoration), store state (auth, entity, tasks, filing history), and component props. Empty-template constants must be copied, not assigned directly. `OfficerIF` requires firstName, lastName, middleInitial for PERSON type and organizationName for ORGANIZATION—documented only in comments, not enforced. `AmalgamationApplicationIF` restricts share classes and incorporation agreement type to BEN/CC/BC/ULC, courtOrder to ULC only. `AddressIF.addressType` is 'mailing' or 'delivery'. `TodoItemIF` optional fields depend on item kind. No runtime logic, entry points, calls out or checks. Types are compile-time only; nothing validates API payloads at runtime. `RestorationIF.expiry` date format undocumented. `TodoItemIF.comments` is always empty and never used. `ComponentIF.$refs` and `StepsIF.component` are typed `any`, bypassing type checking.

structured.condensed:
Vue components that render a business's filing history and pending filings as expandable panels, with a staff-notation menu. They read from Pinia stores and call LegalServices to create draft filings and fetch documents.

**In:** `ApiFilingIF` objects from store getters; `highlightId` prop; `sessionStorage` keys `BUSINESS_ID` and `TEMP_REG_NUMBER`.

**Out:** Drafts via `LegalServices.createFiling(getIdentifier, filing, true)` from `redirectFiling` and `goToRestorationFiling`, reading `header.filingId` or `filing_id` from response, then routing to edit URL with optional `correction-id` query. Documents via `LegalServices.fetchDocument()`. Navigation via `window.location.assign(getDashboardUrl + businessIdentifier + fullPath)`.

**Main flow:** `FilingHistoryList.is()` dispatches to type-specific body components via `EnumUtilities.isType*` checks or `default-filing`. Paid/Approved status shows "Filing Pending". Future-effective filings checked by `isFutureEffectivePending` (Paid + `isFutureEffective` + past date) or `isFutureEffective` (Paid + `isFutureEffective` + future date), rendering different subtitles. Completion with temp registration shows "Retrieve Business Information" button for Amalgamation, ContinuationIn, IncorporationApplication, Registration. ContinuationIn rejected shows `latestReviewComment` and refund message; auto-expands on mount. Consent expiry via `daysBetweenTwoDates < 0`. Staff "| EFFECTIVE as of" text hidden unless put-back-on or administrative dissolution. `onFilingsChange` watcher expands `highlightId` item; `PendingList` opens `highlightId` or panel 0.

**HeaderActions correction menu:** shown if `isRoleStaff` and not `isDisableNonBenCorps`; "Add Detail" requires `isAllowed(AllowableActions.DETAIL_COMMENT)`; `disableCorrection()` checks `isAllowed(CORRECTION)`, paper-only, future-effective, ~30 per-type rules, and `supported-ar-correction-entities` flag for AnnualReport.

**DetailsList "Add Detail":** shown if `!isDisableNonBenCorps && isRoleStaff`, disabled when no `filingId`.

**StaffNotation getters** `showConsentAmalgamateOut`, `showAmalgamateOut`, `showConsentContinueOut`, `showContinueOut` need `(isBaseCompany || isEntityCoop)` and legal type in feature flag list.

**Draft creation failures:** `redirectFiling` logs to console and opens `LoadCorrectionDialog`; `goToRestorationFiling` catches all and shows generic alert; `downloadOne` logs and opens download-error dialog.

**No checks shown:** FilingHistoryList, FilingTemplate, per-type bodies show no permission checks.

GOTCHA: `DocumentsList.downloadAll` catches per-document errors and continues looping—some downloads can fail silently.
GOTCHA: `HeaderActions.disableCorrection()` getters (`getLegalType`, `isEntityCoop`, `isEntityFirm`, `isRoleStaff`) are commented out; checks may fail or throw.
GOTCHA: `StaffNotation.goToRestorationFiling` spinner clears only on error path; real error discarded in catch.

structured.condensed:
These are pytest suites for the legal-api Flask `/api/v1` and `/v2` REST resources. They test the HTTP contract of business, filing, comment, Name Request (NR), document and service endpoints with no production code.

**Entry points:** Every request header includes a JWT with STAFF_ROLE and identifier via `create_header(jwt, [STAFF_ROLE], identifier)`. `BASIC_USER` gets 401 on comment POST/GET. `/meta/info` and OpenAPI root are public. `/ops/healthz` returns 500 if DB unreachable; `/ops/readyz` returns 200. `/meta/info` appends `-{OPENSHIFT_BUILD_COMMIT}` to API and SCHEMAS versions when that env var is set.

**Business reads (all GET, 404 `{message: '{identifier} not found'}` for unknown):** `/businesses/{id}` returns schema-valid JSON with `dissolutionDate` when set. `/addresses` returns `registeredOffice{mailingAddress, deliveryAddress}`. `/aliases`, `/resolutions`, `/share-classes`, `/directors` return lists or 404 `'{identifier} <thing> not found'`. `/tasks` returns `{'tasks': [...]}`.

**Business/filing comments:** POST and GET on `/businesses/{id}/comments` and `/businesses/{id}/filings/{fid}/comments`. Missing/null `businessId`, `filingId`, `comment` → 422. `filingId` differing from URL → 400. Unknown business/filing → 404. PUT/DELETE → 405. Comment shape: `{comment, submitterDisplayName: 'first last', timestamp ISO}`.

**POST /businesses:** Creates bootstrap or incorporation filing. None filing → 400. `?draft=true` with minimal header → 201 echoing identifier and accountId. `?only_validate=true` → 200. Full incorporation with `routingSlipNumber` → 201, filing status PENDING (via `Filing.get_filing_by_payment_token`).

**Directors:** Ceased (`end_date` set) excluded. BCOMP returns delivery+mailing; COOP returns delivery only.

**Address/alias/resolution filters:** `addressType` MAILING or DELIVERY maps to `Address.JSON_MAILING` or `Address.JSON_DELIVERY`; invalid → 400. Alias `type` filters case-insensitively; invalid type → empty list. Resolution `type` filters; invalid → empty list.

**Tasks (`TaskListResource.construct_task_list`):** No filings → todo for each year from post-incorporation to current. BCOMP: 0 current-year todos, 3 if founded 3 years ago. Pending correction appears. `nextAnnualReport` must not be midnight UTC (expects +7/+8 offset). Unknown business → empty tasks.

**NR validation (flag off, `namex.validate_nr`):** Sets `is_consumable`, `is_approved`, `is_expired`, `consent_required`, `consent_received`. `consentFlag` 'R' = required+received, 'Y' = required+not received, 'N'/None/'' = not required. Rejected/expired/consumed NRs not consumable. `namex.get_approved_name` returns first APPROVED or CONDITION name.

**NR validation (flag on):** `validate_nr` returns `skip_nr_check_validation_result` regardless; `get_approved_name` skips state check.

**/nrTypeMap:** Filters by `nrTypeCd`, `entityTypeCd`, `requestActionCd`. No filters → 89 rows. Invalid `nrTypeCd` → 404.

**Other endpoints:** `/documents/{file}/signatures` returns `{key, preSignedUrl}`. `/nameRequests/{nr}` and `/nrTypeMap` are NR lookups. `/nameRequests/NR 1234567` → 404 `'NR 1234567 not found.'`. `update_nr_as_future_effective` extends `expirationDate`; test reverts via `update_nr`.

GOTCHA: No duplicate-comment guard shown. GOTCHA: Feature flag on bypasses NR validation entirely—rejected, expired, consumed NRs all pass. GOTCHA: `test_create_incorporation_success_filing` fetches filing but never asserts equality to sent payload. GOTCHA: NR update test reverts manually, so mid-test failure leaves NR modified.

uses.what: External NR service call used by tests to revert NR changes.

uses.what: Validation module referenced; validates business JSON schema.

uses.what: Feature flag module; when flag is on, NR validation is bypassed entirely.

uses.what: Environment variable; when set, appended to API and SCHEMAS versions in /meta/info.

Background job launcher for the furnishings process in BC Registries (lear). Starts a Flask app, asyncio event loop and QueueService, then runs the furnishing workflow against a legal database, SFTP endpoints, MRAS and Gotenberg APIs, with feature flags via LaunchDarkly and error tracking via Sentry.

Entry point: `furnish.py` called by Dockerfile CMD, run.sh and `make run` - no permission check shown. On any Exception, logs with `application.logger.error(err)` and re-raises; no retry, no state recording. Build system (Makefile) runs pylint, flake8, pytest; supports dev/test/prod promotion by tag; pins pip 20.1.1 and python 3.8.5 (old versions, pip upgrade commented out). Dependencies split between `requirements.txt` (git pins: `registry_schemas` v2.15.38, `legal_api` from bcgov/lear lear with no version lock) and `requirements/prod.txt`, risking drift. Job exits on failure; relies on OpenShift scheduler to retry. Feature flag `enable-involuntary-dissolution = true` static in flags.json. Vault maps to postgres-legal, sentry, launchdarkly, nats-furnishings, entity-service-account, furnishings, sftp-bclaws, sftp-bcmail, mras-api, report-api-gotenberg - call details not shown. structured.condensed:
Service layer for BC legal API that authorizes filings, integrates with external systems (Auth, Namex, COLIN, MRAS, NAICS, Traction), reconstructs versioned business history, publishes events to NATS/STAN, and exposes REST resources for MRAS and NAICS lookup.

**Entry points:** mras GET requires SYSTEM role; naics routes require auth; most services show no caller check. 

**Main flows:** Authorization via `authz.authorized()` checks role (STAFF/SYSTEM/COLIN_SVC pass; ACCOUNT_IDENTITY/CA_SEARCH product pass for 'view'; others query Auth API with 5 retries). Allowability via `authz.is_allowed()` rejects drafts except DRAFT/CHANGE_REQUESTED states, blocks amalgamationApplication for types C/CBEN/CUL/CCC, then matches `get_allowed_filings` table by state and legal type. Blockers from: `has_blocker_filing` (DRAFT_PENDING), `admin_freeze` (BUSINESS_FROZEN), business fields (NOT_IN_GOOD_STANDING/AMALGAMATING_BUSINESS/IN_DISSOLUTION), prior filings/warnings (checked via 5 has_blocker_* functions). Digital credentials require SOLE_PROP, BCSC, self-registered owner, non-staff JWT; `can_access_digital_credentials` decorator returns 404 if missing, 401 if not allowed. NamexService validates NRs: APPROVED consumable, CONDITIONAL needs consentFlag R/N/none, EXPIRED sets flag; `disable-nr-check` bypasses. `get_documents` returns only COMPLETED/PAID/CORRECTED, skips temp/paper/colin-only filings. `VersionedBusinessDetailsService.get_revision()` dispatches by type, uses filing.transaction_id cutoff, excludes operation_type==2, keeps rows with end_transaction_id null or > cutoff. `bootstrap.create_bootstrap()` retries temp identifier (T+9 chars) 5 times on FlushError; `register_bootstrap()` calls `create_affiliation`, rolls back with `delete_affiliation` on failure.

**Outbound:** Auth API (`entities`, `orgs/{id}/affiliations`, `orgs/{id}/products`, `entities/{id}/authorizations`) with bearer token (client credentials, 5 retries backoff 0.1). Namex (`/requests/{nr}`, `/requests/search`, PUT to update) with client credentials. COLIN (`/api/v1/businesses/{id}/public`) with bearer token. MRAS (XML GET `/api/v1/xpr/jurisdictions/{id}`) with x-api-key header. NAICS API with bearer token. Traction (`/out-of-band/create-invitation`, `/issue-credential-2.0/send`, `/issue-credential-2.0/records/{id}`, `/revocation/revoke`, DELETE `/connections/`, `/issue-credential-2.0/records/{id}`) with TRACTION_API_KEY token. Events publish CloudEvents JSON to STAN/NATS via `queue.publish_json()` with specversion, type, source (LEGAL_API_BASE_URL/identifier), id, time, datacontenttype, identifier, data.

**Failure handling:** `publish_event()` swallows exceptions, logs and reports to Sentry only; `QueueService.publish_json()` re-raises. Traction, MrasService, NaicsService, Flags, `get_bearer_token()` log and return None/False. `_register_business_definition()` runs in suppress(Exception). `delete_bootstrap()` suppresses all exceptions. `create_affiliation()` failure on affiliation leaves entity behind (TODO cleanup incomplete). mras 500 returns plain message, not ErrorResponse schema. Hard-coded rule rejects `amalgamationApplication` for C/CBEN/CUL/CCC.

**GOTCHA:** Failed event publish invisible to callers. `delete_bootstrap`, `_register_business_definition`, FurnishingDocumentsService fail silently; `get_bearer_token` returns None, `delete_affiliation` never checks token. `get_digital_credential_data` lacks null checks on founding_date, state, party_roles[0]; Traction JWT decoded without verify_signature. `requires_traction_auth` shows no caller check. No permission check on most services; no duplicate guard on bootstrap; `disable-nr-check` flag can bypass validation.

structured.condensed: Unit tests for pay-api database models. A pytest suite testing record persistence across Comment, CorpType, FeeCode, FilingType, FeeSchedule, Invoice, Payment, PaymentAccount, PaymentMethod, PaymentSystem, PaymentTransaction, Receipt, NonSufficientFunds, RoutingSlip, and EFT family models (EFTCredit, EFTCreditInvoiceLink, EFTFile, EFTRefund, EFTShortnames, EFTShortnameLinks, EFTShortnamesHistorical, EFTTransaction). Each test saves records via `Model.save()` or `session.add()` + `commit()`, then reads them back against a blank database using the `session` fixture and factory helpers. Key behaviours: `Invoice.overdue_date` set 2 months ahead at day 15 with timezone awareness; `Invoice.find_invoices_marked_for_delete()` returns status `DELETE_ACCEPTED` records; `PaymentTransaction.find_stale_records(hours, minutes)` returns only CREATED-status transactions older than threshold, excluding COMPLETED; `FeeSchedule.find_by_filing_type_and_corp_type` returns fee when date in range, None if before `fee_start_date`, unknown type, or both types null; code lookups return None for unknown codes; `RoutingSlip.search(criteria, page, limit, return_all)` filters by `routingSlipNumber`, ignores limit if `return_all=True`; EFT defaults: `EFTFile.status_code` → `IN_PROGRESS`, EFT Refund and ShortnameLinks fields default to null, `EFTTransaction` deposit/transaction dates default to null, `created_on` set to now; `EFTCreditInvoiceLink.get_next_group_link_seq()` supplies `link_group_id`; `EFTShortnamesHistorical` persists `hidden`, `is_processing`, `related_group_link_id`, `statement_number`, `transaction_type` (FUNDS_RECEIVED, STATEMENT_PAID). No authorization, validation or lock checks. `test_status_code.py` fully commented out with wrong docstring; StatusCode uncovered. Several tests assert only `id` not None, missing field-persistence checks. GOTCHA: `test_payment_system` does not assert description persists. GOTCHA: commented-out test and misnamed docstring mask StatusCode coverage gap.
