structured.condensed:
Pytest unit test suite for the pay-api payment service, running against a test database and mocking all external calls (CFS/PayBC, Notify, Keycloak, GCP Pub/Sub, LaunchDarkly, report service). Contains no production code.

Tests pin payment system selection: CC routes to Paybc or InternalPay (zero fees or staff), DIRECT_PAY to DirectPay, DRAWDOWN to Bcol, EFT to Eft, PAD to Pad; PAD blocks until confirmation period passes, invalid corp/filing raises exception. Auth check raises 403 on missing roles. Blockers reject NSF (PAD) and overdue (EFT) invoices. Invoice creation starts as SETTLEMENT_SCHEDULED or COMPLETED (zero amount), deducts from routing slip remaining, soft-deletes cascade payment, rolls back on exception with ServiceUnavailableException. Failed-payment retry consolidates multiple failures into new invoice with sum amount and tracks cons_inv_number. Transaction updates fail on invalid invoice/transaction or missing receipt; DIRECT_PAY hash validated; connection error yields FAILED; queue failure yields EVENT_FAILED; NSF/EFT completion clears flags and reactivates account. Refunds fail for unpaid/duplicate invoices; status depends on method (PAD/ONLINE_BANKING/CC→CREDITED, DRAWDOWN/DIRECT_PAY→REFUND_REQUESTED); PAD APPROVED→CANCELLED; DirectPay rejects PayBC mismatch/excess/already-refunded. EFT credit refund/reversal validates balance; process_cfs_refund handles six scenarios updating link/remaining/history, rejects consolidated invoices. Payment accounts: EFT overrides PAD, future PAD falls back to DRAWDOWN; deletion blocked by outstanding credit/frozen/in-progress. Statement switch to/from EFT creates settings (EFT→MONTHLY, DRAWDOWN→WEEKLY) and may generate interim. Routing slip link sets child LINKED with zero remaining, parent remaining sums children. FeeSchedule applies priority/future-effective/waive/service fees. Business-day calc skips holidays/weekends. BCOL/OAuth map error codes; OAuth converts connection errors to ServiceUnavailableException.

GOTCHA: `test_fee_schedule_with_service_fees_for_basic_user` expects service_fees=10 with `include_service_fees=False`, suggesting flag has no effect. GOTCHA: `test_cfs_service` expects HTTP 400 invalid-bank-account to report status_code 200, masking upstream error. GOTCHA: Several tests assert only that something returned (payment_system_service asserts exception occurred); EFT refund tests do not verify `save` called.

Pay-api database migrations: Alembic revision scripts in `migrations/versions/` that alter the pay-api schema and seed lookup tables (`error_codes` with fields `code`, `title`, `detail`; `routing_slip_status_codes` and `invoice_status_codes` with `code`, `description`). Order enforced via `down_revision` chains. Only caller is Alembic runner, invoking `upgrade()` and `downgrade()` per script.

Routing slip schema adds: parent linking via `parent_number` (foreign key to `routing_slips.number`) with status `LINKED` and errors `RS_ALREADY_A_PARENT`, `RS_ALREADY_LINKED`, `RS_CANT_LINK_TO_SAME`, `RS_CHILD_HAS_TRANSACTIONS`, `RS_PARENT_ALREADY_LINKED`, `RS_IN_INVALID_STATUS`, `RS_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS`, `RS_CANT_LINK_NSF`; lookup errors `RS_DOESNT_EXIST`, `RS_NOT_ACTIVE`; `comments` table keyed to `routing_slips.number`; status lifecycle: `FAS_INVALID_RS_STATUS_CHANGE` for rejected transitions, statuses `CORRECTION`, `VOID`, nullable `cas_version_suffix` backfilled to 1; refund schema: `refunds.routing_slip_id` (foreign key), `refunds.details` (JSONB), nullable `invoice_id` with check requiring at least one; statuses `REFUND_REQUESTED`, `REFUND_AUTHORIZED`, `REFUND_COMPLETED`, `REFUNDED` (invoice), `WRITE_OFF_REQUESTED`, `WRITE_OFF_AUTHORIZED`, `WRITE_OFF_COMPLETED`, `REFUND_UPLOADED`; fields `refund_amount`, `paid_usd_amount`, `total_usd`, `file_type`. Error codes include 16 base codes (invalid ids, `COMPLETED_PAYMENT`, `CANCELLED_PAYMENT`, BCOL account errors), `BCOL_ACCOUNT_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS`, `BCOL_INVALID_ACCOUNT`, `ROUTING_SLIP_REFUND`, `NO_FEE_REFUND`.

No permission or authorization checks shown. No calls to other services, queues, or email. Multiple delete-insert sequences lack existence checks. Downgrades of f50d7a538b8f, c61e4c535a15, 59fc9d74101f are no-ops, irreversible. 175c11863186 and 59fc9d74101f downgrades are incomplete reversals. 7aff4af4be85 downgrade incorrectly reverts pre-`COMPLETE` slips. 10fa4c64f1da drops `parent_id` without data copy to `parent_number`; existing links may be lost.

GOTCHA: Downgrades of f50d7a538b8f, c61e4c535a15, 59fc9d74101f do nothing; upgrades are not reversible.
GOTCHA: 7aff4af4be85 downgrade indiscriminately restores `ACTIVE` status to `COMPLETE` slips with `remaining_amount < 0.01`, including those already `COMPLETE` before the upgrade.
GOTCHA: 10fa4c64f1da migration from `parent_id` to `parent_number` shows no data migration; existing parent links may be lost.

uses.what: Reads lookup table contents and schema changes written by migrations

structured.condensed: Pytest suite for payment-jobs batch tasks (account creation, invoicing, statements, EFT, EJV/AP files, routing slips, refunds, notifications) that exercises task classes calling pay-api models, CFS/PayBC services, SFTP, mailer and AuthEvent publishers. No auth check is shown on any static entry point: `CreateAccountTask.create_accounts()`, `CreateInvoiceTask.create_invoices()`, `StatementTask.generate_statements([date_override])`, `StatementNotificationTask.send_notifications()`, `EFTTask.*`. All outbound calls are mocked. Pinned decisions: PAD activation waits `PAD_CONFIRMATION_PERIOD_IN_DAYS` then transitions PENDING_PAD_ACTIVATION→ACTIVE; account creation routes by type (PAD→PENDING_PAD_ACTIVATION, EFT/online→ACTIVE, routing-slip→ACTIVE INTERNAL CfsAccount). Bank-validation HTTPError (header `CAS-Returned-Messages`) publishes mailer event and sets INACTIVE; system error leaves PENDING. Invoice creation skips CFS if ACTIVE InvoiceReference exists; online banking moves CREATED→SETTLEMENT_SCHEDULED; PAD/EFT stay APPROVED; FREEZE gets no reference; routing-slip HTTPError falls back to `get_invoice` and goes PAID. `BcolRefundConfirmationTask.update_bcol_refund_invoices` moves REFUND_REQUESTED→REFUNDED only when BCOL refund equals negative invoice total (partial stays REFUND_REQUESTED, sends Sentry `capture_message`). `DirectPayAutomatedRefundTask.process_cc_refunds`: refundglstatus PAID→REFUNDED without `gl_posted`, CMPLT→REFUNDED with `gl_posted`, RJCT→`gl_error`. EFT: `link_electronic_funds_transfers_cfs` reverses invoice, creates CFS receipt, marks PAID; Links→COMPLETED (total mismatch or missing invoice returns early); `reverse_electronic_funds_transfers_cfs` moves APPROVED/REFUNDED, deletes receipts; `handle_unlinked_refund_requested_invoices` moves REFUND_REQUESTED→REFUNDED; consolidated invoices raise "Cannot reverse"; overdue accounts unlock once per account. Statements: `StatementDueTask.process_unpaid_statements` sends REMINDER day 21, DUE day 28, then OVERDUE on late invoices, publishes lock, creates `NonSufficientFundsModel`, sets `has_overdue_invoices` (nothing day 10). `StatementTask.generate_statements` handles payment-method transitions, gap statements, removes stale empty statements, reuses IDs. `StatementNotificationTask`: success→SUCCESS, failed/exception→FAILED, flag off→SKIP. `UnpaidInvoiceNotifyTask.notify_unpaid_invoices`: online banking triggers mail from `NOTIFY_AFTER_DAYS`, PAD never; `transactionAmount` sums all unpaid including future-created. Files: `ApTask.create_ap_files` uploads routing-slip refunds (REFUND_AUTHORIZED→REFUND_UPLOADED, idempotent); `EjvPartnerDistributionTask` and `EjvPaymentTask.create_ejv_file` create EjvFile/Header/Link records, UPLOADED; partner disbursement waits `DISBURSEMENT_DELAY_IN_DAYS`; refund produces reversal, payment reversals produce PAYMENT. Routing slips: `link_routing_slips`, `process_nsf`, `process_void`, `process_correction` call `reverse_rs_receipt_in_cfs` and `create_cfs_receipt`, rerun no-op; `adjust_routing_slips` leaves `remaining_amount` at 10 if `adjust_receipt_to_zero` raises, else 0. `DistributionTask.update_failed_distributions` sets REFUNDED/PAID from PayBC (empty response→PAID). GOTCHA: `conftest.py` savepoint wrapper replaces `session.commit` and `session.rollback`, so test commit differs from production. GOTCHA: `factory_receipt` only factory not calling `.save()`. GOTCHA: partner partial-refund EJV test skipped—no coverage. GOTCHA: `test_send_notifications` only asserts True.

structured.condensed:
Queue worker for BC Registries entity emails: subscribes to NATS CloudEvents, records processing state in a separate tracker database, and manages message lifecycle with status transitions.

**In:** CloudEvents JSON (specversion, type, source, id, time, datacontenttype, data) on `NATS_EMAILER_SUBJECT` (default subject, queue and durable `NATS_QUEUE`, defaults `'error'`). **Out:** Publishes to `NATS_ENTITY_EVENT_SUBJECT` (default `entity.events`); references external services (`NOTIFY_API_URL`, `LEGAL_API_URL`, `PAY_API_URL`, NAMEX, account-service) but notes do not show usage.

**Tracker table `message_processing`:** Stores `message_id` (unique, 60 chars), `source` (36), `identifier` (36), `message_type` (35), `status` (10; PROCESSING/FAILED/COMPLETE), `message_json` (JSONB), `message_seen_count` (default 1), `last_error` (1000 chars), `create_date`, `last_update` (both timezone-aware).

**Decisions:** Config selection via `get_named_config` returns ProdConfig (production/staging/default), TestConfig (testing), or DevConfig (development); any other name raises KeyError. Status transitions: `update_message_status()` and `update_message_status_by_message_id()` set status and optionally `last_error`, can increment `message_seen_count`. Lookup by `message_id` or `source` + `message_id` returns record or None; no duplicate guard shown. `MSG_RETRY_NUM` (default 5) configured but notes do not show usage.

**Entry points:** `email_service.py` runs `qsm.run(loop, APP_CONFIG, cb_subscription_handler)` subscribing to emailer subject; handler and email-building logic not shown in notes. `q_cli.py` publishes test messages with `sc.publish(subject, json.dumps(payload).encode())`; no authorization check shown. `manage.py` runs migrations with no permission check.

**Saves and errors:** `save()` commits immediately; `save_to_session()` does not. Service methods commit unconditionally, no error handling or retry. `pre-hook-update-db.sh` runs `python manage.py db upgrade` before deploy, no retry; failed migration fails deploy. `q_cli.py` catches all exceptions, logs and does not re-raise.

**GOTCHA:** No duplicate guard on `create_message()`; redelivered messages could cause IntegrityError. Status update failure after email sent leaves record stuck in PROCESSING with no recovery shown. `update_message_status_by_message_id()` does not check for missing record. No authorization or validation checks anywhere.

Unit test suite for AnnualReport Vue component (annual report filing for COOP and BCOMP businesses). Tests verify component reads/writes to Pinia stores (businessStore, rootStore, configurationStore), interacts with filings API, and redirects to auth/pay webapp.

**Flow:** Component reads pending tasks and draft filings via GET, builds filing payload with directors, addresses, AGM date; POSTs new filing or PUTs draft update; on success, redirects to payment or dashboard based on response and feature flags.

**Entry points:** none shown with authorization checks; form validity gates File & Pay button.

**Decisions:** Page valid (COOP needs four flags: agmDateValid, addressesFormValid, directorFormValid, certifyFormValid; BCOMP needs certifyFormValid only); allowChange('coa'|'cod') returns false if agmDate before last change date, true if date null or agmDate on/after it; didNotHoldAgm=true nullifies annualGeneralMeetingDate; isCertified restored as false; fee option 0=NO_FEE (waiveFees), 1=FAS (routing slip), 2=BCOL (account/DAT/folio); filingId=0 POSTs, filingId>0 PUTs; Save stays on route, SaveResume/Cancel routes to dashboard.

**Calls out:** GET businesses/{id}/tasks, businesses/{id}/filings/{filingId}; POST/PUT businesses/{id}/filings; redirect to AUTH_WEB_URL/makepayment/{paymentToken}/{encodedReturnUrl}?accountid={CURRENT_ACCOUNT} (BCOMP variant: …/makepayment/321/[base.url]?filing_id=123?accountid=…); router.push('dashboard') or utils.navigate('/CP0001191') via feature flag use-business-dashboard.

**Errors:** 400 populates saveErrors/saveWarnings from errors[]/warnings[]; 402 populates saveErrors with [message:'payment required'] and sets isPaymentActionRequired; no retry shown.

**GOTCHA:** Test "disables directors component when Last COD Date is null" asserts true (enabled), contradicting its name. Draft/AGM/director/address change restoration marked FUTURE, untested. Button clicks unverified (methods called directly, not via click handlers).

structured.condensed:
Flask REST layer serving business filings, addresses, parties, documents and digital credentials with invoice creation, NATS events and Minio storage.

Entry points: `@jwt.requires_auth` on most routes; internal routes need `UserRoles.colin`, `UserRoles.system` or `SYSTEM_ROLE`. Filing JSON validated against `filing` schema, 400 on error. POST filing saves it, creates invoice via `PAYMENT_SVC_URL` (stores `payment_token`, `payment_status_code`, `payment_account`). Publishes: `{filing.id}` for COLIN filings to queue; `bc.registry.bnmove` `{oldBn,newBn}` and `bc.registry.business.bn` to NATS topics. Decisions: POST filing requires type in `CoreFiling.NEW_BUSINESS_FILING_TYPES` (400); `RegistrationBootstrapService` needed (503). GET: `slim=true` slim response; `allowed_filings=true` adds allowed filings; `accountId` only for system/account-identity JWTs. `/search` (SYSTEM_ROLE only): empty `identifiers` list is 400; drafts are filings with `temp_reg` and no business. `ListFilingResource.check_authorization` requires both `authorized(edit)` and `is_allowed(...)` pass (401). Validation skipped for `query.draft`, COLIN source before `BOB_DATE`, or `is_before_epoch_filing`. `complete_filing`: COLIN goes to `process_colin_filing` (needs `colin_event_ids`); else runs `check_and_update_nr`, `set_effective_date`, `get_filing_types`, `create_invoice` (402 on payment 400, connection error or timeout). Change-requested filing goes to `resubmit_filing_for_review`, sets Review RESUBMITTED. Filing DELETE: locked filings refused; deletes Minio files and bootstrap for `T`. PATCH: DELETE payment token; 200/202 calls `reset_filing_to_draft`. Document delete only when `is_draft_filing` (403). Digital credentials: `@can_access_digital_credentials` required. `create_invitation`: 409 if active connection exists, reuses pending invitation. `send_credential`: 500 if credential exchange id set. `revoke_credential`: reason SELF_REISSUANCE or SELF_REVOCATION via `reissue` flag. Webhook `/topic/<name>`: `connections` sets active on ACTIVE/COMPLETED; `issuer_cred_rev` records revocation ids when state `issued`; `issue_credential_v2_0` sets `is_issued` when state `done`. Furnishing: staff/system only, 404 for GAZETTE, variant `default`/`greyscale`. Colin sync: `GET /internal/filings` skips corrections without `ColinEventId`, involuntary dissolutions without `BatchProcessing`, amalgamations that raise; PATCH appends `ColinEventId`. `bnmove` updates `tax_id`, creates registrarsNotation filing, publishes events. Tasks: non-consumable Name Request gives 403.

GOTCHA: No permission check on document GET/DELETE, `business.py` GET, `business_tasks`, `save_filing`. Digital credentials webhook has no check. GOTCHA: `bnmove` returns 200 even when business missing or filing creation fails; no null-check or rollback. GOTCHA: PATCH cancel resets filing to DRAFT regardless of payment DELETE response. GOTCHA: `DCConnection` saved before invitation call finishes, leaving orphaned rows. GOTCHA: `construct_task_list` returns string `'pay_connection_error'` instead of list. GOTCHA: `update_colin_event_id` uses raw SQL with f-string.

structured.condensed:
A queue service that consumes entity-event messages from NATS, routes them to type-specific notification handlers, sends emails through the Notify API, publishes events back to NATS, and tracks processing state in a MessageProcessing table.

**In:** `cb_subscription_handler(msg: nats.aio.client.Msg)` receives JSON messages with `email_msg['type']` or legacy nested `['email']['type']`/`['option']`. Cloud-event types: `bc.registry.names.request`, `bc.registry.bnmove`, `bc.registry.affiliation`, `bc.registry.dissolution`. Legacy types: businessNumber, incorporationApplication, annualReport, agmLocationChange, agmExtension, dissolution, registration, changeOfRegistration, restoration, specialResolution, correction, amalgamationApplication, continuationIn, consentContinuationOut, continuationOut.

**Entry guard:** No authorization check; gated only by `is_processable_message`.

**Routing:** names.request → nr_notification; affiliation → affiliation_notification; bnmove → bn_notification.process_bn_move; dissolution → involuntary_dissolution_stage_1_notification (after furnishingName validation against PROCESSABLE_FURNISHING_NAMES); remaining legacy types → their handlers.

**Dedup:** cloud events use source + message_id; legacy use message_id alone. Returns False if seen_count > MSG_RETRY_NUM, status is processing or complete; True if no record or status is FAILED.

structured.condensed:
Unit-test support layer for the Pay API: fixtures, factories and small tests that build payloads and database rows for other pay-api tests.

**Entry points:** Test code calls factories and helpers in `base_test.py`, `decorators.py` and `schema_assertions.py`; no authorization checks in any factory or payload builder. 

**Payloads in:** `get_claims()` returns JWT dict with keys `jti, exp, iat, iss, aud, sub, typ, realm_access, preferred_username, name, username, loginSource, roles, product_code`. `get_payment_request*` variants return `businessInfo` (businessIdentifier, corpType, businessName, contactInfo) and `filingInfo` (filingTypes); some add `accountInfo.routingSlip` or `paymentInfo.methodOfPayment`. Builders also produce auth-service responses, distribution code and schedule payloads, payment account payloads, routing slip and PayBC transaction requests.

**Main flows:** Config selection by environment: `development`→`DevConfig`, `testing`→`TestConfig`, others→`ProdConfig`. `GET /api/v1/codes/errors` returns 200 with non-empty `codes` array; unknown code type returns `codes` as `None`. `setup_logging()` with config file prints to stdout; with `None` prints to stderr. `get_run_version()` returns `__version__`.

**Database writes:** Factories create and save rows to test Postgres: `factory_payment_account` saves `PaymentAccount` then linked `CfsAccount` (cfs_party=11111, cfs_site=29921); `factory_premium_payment_account` returns unsaved. `activate_pad_account` sets `pad_activation_date` and `cfs_account.status=ACTIVE`. `factory_payment_line_item` looks up `fee_distribution_id` via `DistributionCode.find_by_active_for_fee_schedule`. Factories for invoice reference, receipt, payment transaction and routing slip each build their row. Defaults: role=`Role.EDITOR`, statement frequency=`WEEKLY`, EFT payment method, EFT refund status=`PENDING`, EFT history=`SN_REFUND_PENDING_APPROVAL`.

**Validation:** `assert_valid_schema(data, schema_file)` loads JSON schema from `tests/utilities/schemas/<file>` and calls `jsonschema.validate`; no handling for missing file, bad JSON or validation failure beyond the exception.

**Conditional skip:** `skip_in_pod` skips test when `POD_TESTING` environment variable is truthy; `decorators.py` loads `.env` via `load_dotenv(find_dotenv())`.

**GOTCHA:** `factory_eft_credit_invoice_link` does not call `.save()` unlike other EFT factories; tests must persist the row themselves or silently run against missing data. `factory_premium_payment_account` returns unsaved account; using it as persisted fails. `skip_in_pod` hides tests when `POD_TESTING` is set, so version-test regression goes unseen in pods.

Unit tests for the business-dashboard Vue front end, covering dashboard, address and party lists, office-address and filing screens under Jest/Vue Test Utils. Axios, LegalServices and window.location.assign are mocked; no real API is called. Tests document expected behaviour only, not component code.

Components read Pinia stores (`businessStore`: setLegalType, setIdentifier, setAllowedActions; `rootStore`: registeredAddress, recordsAddress, businessAddress, parties, setFilingData, currentDate). Legal API calls: GET `businesses/{id}/tasks`, GET `businesses/{id}/filings/{filingId}` (resume draft), GET `businesses/{id}/addresses?date=…` via OfficeAddresses.getOrigAddresses, POST/PUT `businesses/{id}/filings` (file new or update draft, with `?draft=true` for draft). Request/response body: `{filing: {header, business, changeOfAddress | agmLocationChange | consentAmalgamationOut}}`; response header carries filingId, paymentToken, status, isPaymentActionRequired. Payment redirects via `window.location.assign` to `{VUE_APP_AUTH_WEB_URL}/makepayment/{paymentToken}/{encoded BASE_URL?filing_id=…}?accountid={CURRENT_ACCOUNT}` (BASE_URL, CURRENT_ACCOUNT from sessionStorage). OfficeAddresses emits `original`, `update:addresses`, `modified`; TodoList emits `todo-count`.

**Dashboard:** standalone buttons enabled only if allowedActions contains filing type; disabled when filing types empty, business ID missing, or future-effective COA pending. Filings classified by FilingStatus and FilingTypes into isBootstrapTodo, isBootstrapFiling, isBootstrapPending. filingId from $route.query.filing_id. COOP #standalone-addresses-button routes to standalone-addresses with filingId='0'; BENEFIT_COMPANY opens COA warning dialog first, proceed routes; #standalone-directors-button routes to standalone-directors.

**Standalone office address filing:** isPageValid = certifyFormValid AND addressesFormValid AND filingData.length > 0. New filing (filingId '0') POSTs and redirects to payment; draft (filingId '123') PUTs and routes to dashboard if isPaymentActionRequired false; with feature flag use-business-dashboard on, navigates to /CP0001191?filing_id=123. onClickSave does not redirect; onClickSaveResume routes to dashboard. Draft header has certifiedBy, email; routingSlipNumber undefined. Resume restores certifiedBy, filingId, addresses, staffPaymentData (BCOL staff payment option 2 with bcolAccountNumber, datNumber, folioNumber, isPriority; No Fee option 0). 400 error sets saveErrorReason, saveErrors, saveWarnings; 402 error surfaces saveErrors.

**AGM location change:** isPageValid needs agmLocationValid, agmYearValid, certifyFormValid, reasonValid. isPayRequired true only if totalFee > 0. filingData holds one item (AGMLC, BEN).

**Consent to amalgamate out:** CourtOrderPoa for staff only. Draft save updates filingId via LegalServices.createFiling; File & Pay redirects to payment.

**Address and party lists** (AddressListSm, FirmsAddressList, DirectorListSm, CustodianListSm, ProprietorPartnersListSm, SummaryOfficeAddresses): matching delivery and mailing render "Same as above"; records office equal to registered office renders "Same as Registered Office". showGrayedOut adds disabled, sets toggle tabindex=-1, hides icons. showCompleteYourFilingMessage renders "Complete your filing to display". Null/empty addresses render "(Not entered)". Proprietor and partner lists filtered by CorpTypeCd.SOLE_PROP or PARTNERSHIP. Records office panel applies to BENEFIT_COMPANY and COOP; BC offices have registered and records addresses; COOP flat address. OfficeAddresses: #reg-off-addr-change-btn exists only when componentEnabled true; #recSameAsReg and #regMailSameAsDeliv appear only when addresses match.

GOTCHA: no authorization check in any spec; only role check is staff-only CourtOrderPoa with keycloakRoles=[user]. GOTCHA: form validity and fees (certifyFormValid, addressesFormValid, totalFee) set directly in test setup; specs do not show whether component enforces them. GOTCHA: AddressListSm.spec test three uses selector #business-address-panell (typo); can pass without checking anything. GOTCHA: SummaryOfficeAddresses.spec comment says "same as registered" not displayed, but assertion expects it displayed.

Unit test suite for the StandaloneDirectorsFiling Vue component, a change-of-directors filing page, pinning page validity, draft resume, file-and-pay, save and error handling for business CP0001191.

Edit page is valid when: changeOfDirectorsDate valid AND director form valid AND certify form valid AND filingData non-empty. Review page is valid when: certify form valid AND filingData non-empty. File & Pay button enabled when isReviewPageValid=true in filing review mode.

Certify component receives section code by entity type; COOP reads "Section 78 of the Cooperative Association Act". Draft resume (filingId='123' in query) fetches draft, restores certifiedBy and staffPaymentData, stores filingId. Three staff payment options: 0=NO_FEE, 1=FAS with routingSlipNumber and isPriority, 2=BCOL with bcolAccountNumber, datNumber, folioNumber, isPriority.

onDirectorsPaidChange(true/false) adds/removes 'OTCDR' fee code; onDirectorsFreeChange(true/false) adds/removes 'OTFDR'. onClickFilePay: if isPaymentActionRequired=true, calls window.location.assign with makepayment URL and encoded callback (COOP, BENEFIT_COMPANY); else routes to dashboard. New filing routes to dashboard with filing_id query param; with use-business-dashboard flag navigates via utils.navigate() to /CP0001191?filing_id=123. onClickSave() saves draft without routing; onClickSaveResume() saves and routes to dashboard.

Mocked endpoints: GET filings/123 (draft with changeOfDirectors.directors, business, header), GET tasks (empty or populated), POST filings (pending with paymentToken='321', isPaymentActionRequired=true) and POST filings?draft=true (draft with header.filingId=123), PUT filings/123 (pending, isPaymentActionRequired=false). structured.condensed:
The core domain package for legal-api holds the Filing class, business identifiers and helpers, display names, and JSON diffing; it reads and writes FilingStorage and Business models and calls VersionedBusinessDetailsService and VersionService for historical revisions.

Entry points: Filing.get() and Filing.get_json() (static, no check shown); Filing.ledger() and document-links method (static, no check shown); FilingMeta.display_name() (static, no check shown); BusinessIdentifier.validate_format() and next_identifier() (static, no check shown).

Filing.get_json() branches by filing status: COMPLETED calls VersionedBusinessDetailsService.get_revision(id, business_id); APPROVED/PAID/PENDING returns tech_correction_json if present else raw; all other statuses return raw. Filing.get() reads FilingStorage when identifier starts with 'T' (temporary), else calls Business.get_filing_by_id().

Filing.redact_submitter() returns True when submitter roles include staff or system and caller JWT lacks staff; ledger and get_most_recent_filing_json then show REDACTED_STAFF_SUBMITTER ('Registry Staff'). GOTCHA: suppresses KeyError and TypeError silently, so malformed role list means no redaction applied.

Document links: no_output_filings (CONVERSION, COURTORDER, PUTBACKON, REGISTRARSNOTATION, REGISTRARSORDER) get empty documents except COURT_ORDER documents; legalFilings link added for PAID/AWAITING_REVIEW/CHANGE_REQUESTED/APPROVED/REJECTED except no_legal_filings_in_paid_status and sole proprietorship/partnership dissolution; receipt link added when payment_completion_date set; COMPLETED/CORRECTED use FilingMeta.get_all_outputs and alter_outputs; coop SPECIALRESOLUTION adds specialResolutionApplication; staff also get FilingMeta.get_static_documents.

FilingMeta.display_name() resolves in order: FILINGS keyed by legal_type or plain string, else sub-type, else camelCase split of filing type (legal_type from business revision at filing's transaction); adds year for annualReport, recurses for correction; administrative dissolution and unfreeze have fixed names.

FilingMeta.alter_outputs() runs alteration, correction, special-resolution and dissolution variants adding/removing document names (certificateOfNameChange, certifiedRules, certifiedMemorandum, certificateOfDissolution, others). GOTCHA: assigns modified outputs but never returns them; callers may lose alterations; .remove() raises KeyError when document absent; suppress(Exception) in correction path hides errors.

FILINGS metadata holds per-type name, displayName, fee codes by corp type, and extra outputs (e.g., administrative dissolution uses DIS_ADM for C/CBEN/CUL/CCC, incorporation uses BCINC or OTINC for CP).

BusinessIdentifier.validate_format() requires non-digit prefix that is a BusinessType plus all digits; next_identifier() pads sequence to 7 digits or returns None if lookup fails.

filing_helper has two special-resolution correction detectors: one reads meta_data['correction'] (used by reports post-filer), one reads filing JSON (used by filer and emailer).

Filing.save() writes filing_json and payment_account through storage.save(). No authorization checks shown on any entry point; only role checks in redact_submitter (staff gate) using has_roles(jwt, [UserRoles.staff]). No external service calls, only DB models and versioning services.

GOTCHA: diff_list treats id-less rows in json1 as additions even when json2 has identical row; ignores id-less rows in json2, so diffs can be wrong.

structured.condensed:
Queue worker that subscribes to NATS filing messages and applies each filed submission to the business database, then publishes notifications to NATS, GCP, email, and business-profile services.

**In:** NATS message with `filing_msg['filing']['id']` as UTF-8 JSON, handled by `cb_subscription_handler(msg)`.

**Flow:** `process_filing` loads the filing via `FilingCore.find_by_id`, checks if status is already COMPLETED (returns silently if so; reprocessing guard), writes business, filing and transaction records through `versioning_manager`, sets filing status and `transaction_id` via `set_processed(business_type)`. Routes each key in `legal_filings` to a type-specific handler (alteration, annualReport, changeOfAddress, changeOfDirectors, changeOfName, dissolution, incorporationApplication, registration, conversion, courtOrder, registrarsNotation, registrarsOrder, correction, transition, changeOfRegistration, putBackOn, restoration, adminFreeze, consentContinuationOut, continuationOut, agmLocationChange, agmExtension, amalgamationApplication, continuationIn); `specialResolution` has separate check. Sets `is_correction` when filing type is CORRECTION. New-business filings (AMALGAMATIONAPPLICATION, CONTINUATIONIN, CONVERSION, INCORPORATIONAPPLICATION, REGISTRATION) update `business_id`, call `business_profile.update_affiliation` (except CONVERSION), consume name request, update business profile, publish MRAS email. Others call `business_profile.update_entity` and conditionally `name_request.consume_nr`. Stamps PDF via PdfService, uploads to Minio with `MinioService.put_file`.

**Out:** `publish_event` sends CloudEvent to NATS with filing header, business identifier, filing types, and `tempidentifier` if `filing.temp_reg` set. `publish_gcp_queue_event` sends SimpleCloudEvent to GCP with type `bc.registry.business.<filing_type>`. `publish_email_message` and `publish_mras_email` (AMALGAMATIONAPPLICATION, CONTINUATIONIN, INCORPORATIONAPPLICATION only) send email.

**Decisions:** Raises `QueueException` if no Flask app or filing not found. annualReport, changeOfAddress, dissolution check `enable-involuntary-dissolution` flag.

**Entry guard:** no authentication or permission check; only Flask-app check and COMPLETED-status check.

**Error policy:** `OperationalError` re-raised (blocks queue). `FilingException` re-raised (reprocesses). `QueueException` and others reported to Sentry and logged, message dropped with no retry. Publish failures caught broadly, only logged/Sentry, never retried.

**GOTCHA:** Publish failures (event, GCP, email, MRAS) swallowed after DB commit; downstream systems miss notifications with no retry. Catch-all in handler discards unexpected errors; filing lost with no retry. Multiple commits enable partial updates when later step fails. COMPLETED guard returns silently; half-applied filing undetected.

structured.condensed: Per-filing-type processors in the entity-filer queue service that apply filing JSON to Business and Filing models via shared helpers in filing_components/. Each processor takes (business, filing dict, filing_rec, filing_meta); creation processors return a new Business and write identifier, legalType, foundingDate to filing_rec._filing_json (skipped if colin_event_ids present). Callers must persist; processors never commit. Key decisions: QueueException raised when filing key missing, business exists (for creations), or no corp_num obtained; transition raises if business missing. Dissolution sets state HISTORICAL with date from dissolutionDate (VOLUNTARY SP/GP) else effective_date; ADMINISTRATIVE deletes amalgamation records; flag_on + QUEUED batches become COMPLETED. Annual_report with flag_on + in_dissolution checks InvoluntaryDissolutionService.check_business_eligibility; ineligible makes batch WITHDRAWN. Change_of_address with flag_on + in_dissolution moves trigger_date 62 days out if within 60. Change_of_directors ceases active directors missing from filing (colin only), treats ceased-in-DB with no cessation as newly appointed. Parties: COMPLETING_PARTY, INCORPORATOR, APPLICANT to filing.filing_party_roles; others to business.party_roles. Shares.update_share_structure replaces all; _correction diffs. Offices/aliases delete and replace. Business_profile.update_affiliation creates, deletes on fail, then calls update_entity. Consent_continuation_out.get_expiry_date returns effective_date + 6 months adjusted for DST. COLIN API, Account service, NAMEX, and Minio called with bearer tokens; COLIN and NAMEX not retried on error. No authorization check in any processor. GOTCHA: Silent suppression in many processors (suppress IndexError, KeyError, TypeError, ValueError). GOTCHA: Broken guard in filings.update_filing_court_order (checks class not instance). GOTCHA: Partial application—deletions and Minio writes not atomic; failed steps leave half-updated business; rules_and_memorandum file already stamped when later step fails. GOTCHA: No duplicate guard shown. GOTCHA: Many error returns dropped by callers (offices, parties, shares, aliases); dissolution logs failed custodial office creation only; name_request and business_profile failures logged to Sentry, not re-raised.

uses.name: COLIN API
uses.what: POST {COLIN_API}/{business_type} with bearer token to get_next_corp_num(); returns None on ConnectionError with no retry.

uses.name: Account service
uses.what: POST/PUT {ACCOUNT_SVC_ENTITY_URL}/{identifier}/contacts with bearer token via business_profile.py for affiliation create/delete and entity update.

uses.name: NAMEX
uses.what: PATCH with bearer token via name_request.consume_nr; payload {'state':'CONSUMED','corpNum'} if namex-nro-decommissioned flag on, else {'consume':{'corpNum'}}; failures logged to Sentry, not re-raised.

uses.name: Minio
uses.what: Fetch file via rules_and_memorandum, dissolution._update_cooperative, incorporation_filing._update_cooperative; call replace_file_with_certified_copy() for registrar stamp; attach Document.

uses.name: Business model
uses.what: Apply filing to Business and update identifier, legalType, foundingDate, party_roles, share classes, offices, aliases, state, dates; processors never commit, caller persists.

uses.name: Filing model
uses.what: Update Filing with filing_json (including identifier, legalType, foundingDate for creations), filing_party_roles, court_order; write to filing_rec._filing_json bypassing property.

uses.name: filing_meta
uses.what: Record filing summary; processor updates before later step can fail.

uses.name: colin_event_ids
uses.what: If present, incorporation_filing and continuation_in skip writing identifier, legalType, foundingDate to filing_rec._filing_json.

uses.name: namex-nro-decommissioned flag

structured.condensed: Core application factory, configuration, error handling and utilities for the Payment API (pay_api v1.22.3). Entry point is `create_app(run_mode)` from env var `DEPLOYMENT_ENV` with no validation. Responses flow through three hooks: `convert_to_camel` converts keys to camelCase, `add_version` sets the `pay_api/{version}` header, `set_access_control_header` sets `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` and allows `Authorization`, `Content-Type`, `registries-trace-id` and `Account-Id` headers. Errors return as `application/problem+json`; `BusinessException` stores code, status and detail; `as_problem_json()` looks up the code in the codes table via `CodeService.find_code_value_by_type_and_code(Code.ERROR, code)`, falling back to `{type: code, detail}` if not found. `ServiceUnavailableException` sets status `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`. Migration runs via Alembic only when not testing and `CLOUD_PLATFORM != 'OCP'`. Cache builds via `build_cache()` which calls `CodeService.build_all_codes_cache()`, skipped when `TESTING=True`; cache-build failure is logged but not re-raised, leaving the app with empty cache. Sentry initializes only when `SENTRY_ENABLE='true'`. `UserContext` (injected by `@user_context` decorator) reads the pre-validated JWT from `g.jwt_oidc_token_info` and provides role checks (`is_staff`, `is_system`, `is_sandbox`, `has_role`) and permission checks: `can_view_bank_info` requires permission `admin`, `view` or `manage_bank_info`; `can_view_bank_account_number` requires `admin` or `view_bank_account_number`. Account ID resolved from token, then `g.account_id`, then `Account-Id` header. Feature flags via `flags.py` (`is_on`, `value`) return caller's default when LaunchDarkly client unavailable or fails; in tests reads local `flags.json`; no anonymous context provided. Redirect validation matches `VALID_REDIRECT_URLS` with wildcards, bypassed when `DISABLE_VALID_REDIRECT_URLS=true`. Topic routing via `util.py`: `CorpType.NRO` → `NAMEX_PAY_TOPIC`, product `BUSINESS` or `BUSINESS_SEARCH` → `BUSINESS_PAY_TOPIC`, `STRR` → `STRR_PAY_TOPIC`, else `None`. BC Online error mapping via `get_bcol_error`: codes 7 unavailable, 20 closed, 21 user revoked, 48 account revoked, 61 insufficient funds, 5 invalid account, others generic error. GOTCHA: no validation of `run_mode` parameter; CORS allows `*`; insecure defaults (`SECRET_KEY='a secret'`, `CLOUD_PLATFORM='OCP'` silently skips migrations); code-cache failure is silent; this package assumes token already verified by `jwt`/`flask_jwt_oidc` layer.

uses.what: configuration settings used by other modules

uses.name: Sentry
uses.what: DSN sent to Sentry when initialized

uses.what: configuration flag; skips cache build and Alembic migration when true

uses.what: defaults to 'OCP'; when not 'OCP', Alembic migration runs

structured.condensed:
HTTP resource layer for payment, invoice, refund and account operations in Flask-restplus/Blueprint, validating JSON against schemas and checking JWT role/account auth before delegating to services.

**Entry Points:** 21 blueprints registered by `V1Endpoint.init_app()` on app startup. Auth via `@_jwt.requires_auth` or `@_jwt.has_one_of_roles([...])`, with account-level checks using `check_auth(business_identifier, account_id, contains_role/one_of_roles, is_premium)` defined outside this chunk.

**Validation & Response:** Requests validated with `schema_utils.validate(json, '<schema>')`, returning 400 with `Error.INVALID_REQUEST` on failure. Outputs are JSON or PDF/CSV with `Content-Disposition` and `Access-Control-Expose-Headers`.

**Key Decisions:** POST `/accounts` returns 202 if `cfs_account_status=PENDING`, else 201; `viewAll=true` purchase-history search requires `VIEW_ALL_TRANSACTIONS`, `EDITOR`, clears account filter; statement reads/POSTs need `EDIT_ROLE`/`CHANGE_STATEMENT_SETTINGS` and `is_premium=True`; invoice DELETE returns 202; payment POST routes STAFF+`CREATE_CREDITS` through `create_payment_receipt`, others through `create_account_payment` using `enable-eft-payment-method`, `retryFailedPayment`, `payOutstandingBalance`, `allInvoiceStatuses` flags; refund POST (202) needs SYSTEM/`CREATE_CREDITS`/`FAS_REFUND`; EFT refund PATCH returns 404 if not found; FAS routing-slip search without `page` sets `return_all`; FAS comment validated against `comment` then `comment_bcrs_schema`; routing slips have role prefix `FAS_CREATE/SEARCH/REPORTS/VIEW/EDIT/LINK`.

**Public endpoints (no auth shown):** `code.py`, `fee_schedule.py` (CORS `*`); `meta.py` `/v1/meta/info`; `ops.py` `/ops/healthz`, `/ops/readyz` run `select 1`, return 200, return 500 on `SQLAlchemyError`.

**Services called:** `PaymentService.create_invoice`, `create_payment_receipt`, `create_account_payment`, `accept_delete` (invoice), `CFSService.validate_bank_account`, raising `BusinessException` or `ServiceUnavailableException` converted to `exception.response()`.

**Failures:** No retries, no failure recording; exceptions only become HTTP responses.

GOTCHA: `transaction.py` POST and PATCH show no `@_jwt.requires_auth` decorator; POST creates and PATCH writes `payResponseUrl`. GOTCHA: Three `eft_short_names.py` routes—`get_eft_shortname_links`, `post_eft_shortname_link`, `post_eft_statement_payment`—lack `@_jwt.requires_auth`; notes claim role checks but chunk shows none. GOTCHA: `invoice_receipt.py` has unreachable code (debug log in GET, `jsonify` in POST) after returns. GOTCHA: `invoice.py` DELETE and refund POST validate body only if role present.

uses.name: schema_utils.validate()
uses.what: JSON request body against named schema; returns errors serialized via schema_utils.serialize() on failure.

uses.name: check_auth()
uses.what: Account authorization with business_identifier, account_id, role condition (contains_role or one_of_roles), premium flag; defined outside this chunk.

uses.name: @_jwt.requires_auth
uses.what: Decorator enforcing JWT presence on decorated routes.

uses.name: @_jwt.has_one_of_roles([])
uses.what: Decorator enforcing JWT roles in list on decorated routes.

uses.name: PaymentService.create_invoice()
uses.what: Creates invoice; raises BusinessException.

uses.name: PaymentService.create_payment_receipt()
uses.what: STAFF+CREATE_CREDITS payment flow for EFT/DRAWDOWN; raises BusinessException.

uses.name: PaymentService.create_account_payment()
uses.what: General payment creation using enable-eft-payment-method, retryFailedPayment, payOutstandingBalance, allInvoiceStatuses flags; raises BusinessException.

uses.name: InvoiceService.accept_delete()
uses.what: Deletes invoice; returns 202.

uses.name: CFSService.validate_bank_account()
uses.what: Validates bank account; raises BusinessException or ServiceUnavailableException.

uses.name: RefundService
uses.what: Handles refunds requiring SYSTEM, CREATE_CREDITS or FAS_REFUND; body validated only if role present.

uses.name: RoutingSlipService
uses.what: FAS routing slips with roles FAS_CREATE/SEARCH/REPORTS/VIEW/EDIT/LINK; comment validated against comment then comment_bcrs_schema.

uses.name: EFTShortnameService
uses.what: EFT operations; search, patch, links need SYSTEM or MANAGE_EFT.

uses.name: StatementService
uses.what: Account statements; reads need EDIT_ROLE, POSTs need CHANGE_STATEMENT_SETTINGS and is_premium=True.

uses.name: exception.response()
uses.what: Converts BusinessException and ServiceUnavailableException into HTTP responses.

uses.name: error_to_response()
uses.what: Returns error JSON with Error.INVALID_REQUEST and invalid_params on schema validation failure.

uses.name: SQLAlchemyError
uses.what: Caught in /ops/healthz and /ops/readyz; returns 500 if raised during select 1.

structured.condensed:
Builds and configures the Legal API Flask service, initializing endpoints, database, queue, JWT, and error handlers. 

Entry point is `create_app(run_mode)`, which returns a configured Flask app and checks no caller permissions. The app reads config from `CONFIGURATION[run_mode]`, which must be `_Config`, `TestConfig`, or `DevConfig` or raises `KeyError`. Initialization order: database, rsbc_schemas, flags, queue, babel, endpoints, then digital_credentials in app context, then cache, then JWT via `setup_jwt_manager` (reads roles from `realm_access.roles`). Sentry integrates if `SENTRY_DSN` is set, using release `legal-api@{version}` and `send_default_pii=False`.

Environment variables configure downstream targets: service URLs (COLIN, PAYMENT, AUTH, REPORT, NAMEX, MRAS, NAICS, TRACTION), database, JWT/OIDC, NATS subjects (filer, entity-event, emailer), and Minio bucket.

Error handling: `handle_http_error` returns `RoutingException` as-is, other `HTTPException` as `{'message': error.description}` with `error.code`. `handle_uncaught_error` logs other exceptions with `exc_info`, returns 500 `{'message': 'Internal server error'}`.

`ProdConfig` missing `SECRET_KEY` prints warning and generates random 24-byte key. `TestConfig` sets `JWT_OIDC_TEST_MODE=True` with test keys and Minio at localhost:9000/minio/minio123. `cors_preflight(methods)` adds OPTIONS handler with CORS origin `*`, headers `Authorization, Content-Type`, and `Allow: GET` regardless of passed methods. `setup_logging(conf)` loads `logging.conf` if file exists, else writes to stderr.

GOTCHA: Base `_Config` hardcodes `SECRET_KEY = 'a secret'`—non-production environments sign with known key. GOTCHA: `ProdConfig` random key differs per process—signatures won't validate across replicas or restarts. GOTCHA: `cors_preflight` always sends `Allow: GET`, misreporting supported methods. GOTCHA: No authorization checks in this module; guards live elsewhere.

structured.condensed: Defines the business-rule error vocabulary for legal-api: an exception type carrying an error and HTTP status, error codes with message templates, and enum helpers. No authorization or validation enforced here; callers elsewhere check permissions before raising `NOT_AUTHORIZED`. Entry points: `BusinessException(error, status_code, *args, **kwargs)` accepts any caller and stores error and status; `Error(code, msg)` holds non-exception returns; `get_error_message(error_code, **kwargs)` looks up template in `ERROR_MESSAGES`, applies babel localization, formats with placeholders—missing kwargs are replaced by their key name instead of raising. Error codes (`FILING_NOT_FOUND`, `MISSING_BUSINESS`, `NOT_AUTHORIZED`, `FURNISHING_NOT_FOUND`) map to templates with named placeholders (`filing_id`, `identifier`, `furnishing_id`). Enum bases provide `BaseEnum` (str + Enum), `BaseMeta.__contains__` for membership test, `get_enum_by_value(cls, value)` for value lookup. No commits, retries, or logging. GOTCHA: new `ErrorCode` without `ERROR_MESSAGES` entry silently returns None; add both together. GOTCHA: misspelled kwarg leaves key name in user-facing text instead of failing. GOTCHA: `BusinessException` doesn't tie `status_code` to error—same code can reach clients with different statuses.

Queue worker that routes digital-credential messages to processors that revoke, replace or issue credentials through legal_api. In: queue message with type and data (identifier and filingId required for filing types). Out: calls to legal_api.services.digital_credentials (revoke_credential, issue_credential, remove_credential_exchange_record); writes DCIssuedCredential records. Decisions: missing identifier or unknown business raises exception; unsupported type raises nothing; missing filingId for filing types raises QueueException. Each processor first checks get_issued_digital_credentials; if empty, logs warning and stops. admin_revoke and put_back_on revoke with specific reasons; business_number and change_of_registration (if nameRequest present) replace with UPDATED_INFORMATION; dissolution branches on filing sub_type (voluntary replaces, administrative revokes, other raises exception). Revoke requires is_issued and not is_revoked, active connection, succeeds if revoke_credential returns {} or None (None raises exception, is_revoked stays False). Replace revokes first if needed, removes exchange record (None raises), looks up DCIssuedBusinessUserCredential and User (missing raises), deletes old credential, then issues new one. Issue requires DCDefinition and active connection; failure or None return raises exception; success saves record with credential_exchange_id.

GOTCHA: replace deletes old credential before new issue succeeds—failed issue leaves business with no credential, no rollback shown. GOTCHA: this chunk shows no authorization check. GOTCHA: this chunk shows no retry on revoke_credential or issue_credential failure. GOTCHA: dissolution test passes hardcoded string 'test' where filing expected—real sub_type handling not visible.

Entry points: `GET /api/v1/eft-shortnames` (Role.MANAGE_EFT, filters by statementId, amountOwing, state, accountName, accountBranch, accountId, accountIdList, shortName, page, limit; returns paginated items); `GET /api/v1/eft-shortnames/summaries` (Role.MANAGE_EFT, filters by shortName, linkedAccountsCount, paymentReceivedStartDate/EndDate, shortNameId, creditsRemaining, page, limit); `GET|POST /{id}/links` and `PATCH /{id}/links/...` (Role.MANAGE_EFT); `GET /{id}/history` (Role.MANAGE_EFT); `PATCH /{id}` (Role.MANAGE_EFT, updates casSupplierNumber and email, invalid email gives 400); `POST /{id}/payment` (CORS-only check); `POST /api/v1/eft-shortnames/shortname-refund` (EFT_REFUND, creates EFTRefundModel and history SN_REFUND_PENDING_APPROVAL with credit_balance=0, emails via LegalServices, returns 202, invalid body gives 400 INVALID_REQUEST); `GET /api/v1/eft-shortnames/shortname-refund` (EFT_REFUND, accepts ?status filter); `PATCH /api/v1/eft-shortnames/shortname-refund/{refund_id}` (EFT_REFUND_APPROVER only—401 if absent, PENDING_APPROVAL→PENDING_APPROVAL gives 400 REFUND_ALREADY_FINALIZED; APPROVED sets history SN_REFUND_APPROVED, DECLINED sets SN_REFUND_DECLINED and restores eft_credit.remaining_amount); `POST /api/v1/payment-requests/{inv_id}/refunds` (Role.SYSTEM, returns 202). Link creation auto-allocates EFTCredit as PENDING, requires accountId (400 EFT_SHORT_NAME_ACCOUNT_ID_REQUIRED if absent), rejects duplicate account mapping (400 EFT_SHORT_NAME_ALREADY_MAPPED). Link PATCH rejects LINKED→LINKED (400 EFT_SHORT_NAME_LINK_INVALID_STATUS), allows LINKED→INACTIVE. History isReversible true for STATEMENT_PAID only; FUNDS_RECEIVED has null account fields; is_processing true only for statement_reverse; created_by 'STAFF USER' when staff present. Payment refund: EFT makes first invoice CANCELLED and second REFUND_REQUESTED; PAD increases account credit; routing slip adds to remainingAmount; duplicate on same invoice gives 400; invoice not PAID gives 400 INVALID_REQUEST with no RefundModel written; DirectPayService.process_cfs_refund raising BusinessException DIRECT_PAY_INVALID_RESPONSE returns as 400 with detail; DIRECT_PAY needs receipt_number preset. Statement summary GET returns totalDue, shortNameLinksCount, isEftUnderPayment (true when EFTCredit.remaining_amount below sum of APPROVED invoices across linked accounts, false when equal; both linked accounts report same). GOTCHA: link creation silently allocates credit—a bug changes EFTCredit balances. GOTCHA: DECLINED refund must restore remaining_amount or credit is lost. GOTCHA: refund POST email via LegalServices shows no failure handling. GOTCHA: no retry or failure recording for refunds or emails shown.

structured.condensed:
Unit tests for the pay-api Flask REST API, covering endpoints under `/api/v1/` and `/ops`; the tests are the executable specification of endpoint behaviour. Tests call endpoints through a test client with JWT bearer tokens, mock outbound calls to CFS/PayBC, DirectPayService, and email, and use models and services directly for setup and assertions.

Requests carry a Bearer JWT from `jwt.create_jwt(get_claims(), token_header)`, some with an `Account-Id` header. Account create: `Role.SYSTEM` gives 201; `Role.EDITOR` gives 401; duplicate gives 400; `?sandbox=true` requires `CREATE_SANDBOX_ACCOUNT` (else 403). PAD status returns 200, 202 or 503 by CFS state; EFT and ONLINE_BANKING return 202 even if CFS is down. Switching EFT→PAD gives 400 if unpaid APPROVED invoice exists. Account read masks `bankAccountNumber` for user role, not system. Payment queries: `viewAll=true` gives 403; bad `businessIdentifier` gives 400; service account sees only its `product_code` invoices. Fee lookup: `valid_date` outside schedule window gives 400; `waiveFees` only for staff; `quantity` multiplies fee; account fee settings (`serviceFeeCode` TRF01=1.5, TRF02=1.0) change `filingFees` and `serviceFees`. Distributions require `MANAGE_GL_CODES` (STAFF gets 401).

Payment request create logic: EJV for gov, PAD for activated PAD, DRAWDOWN for premium/staff, DIRECT_PAY for CC. Zero-dollar waive-fees needs staff (401 without), gives COMPLETED. PASSCODE login gives 403. Mismatched `product_code` claim gives 403. Non-activated PAD gives 400 `ACCOUNT_IN_PAD_CONFIRMATION_PERIOD`. `businessIdentifier` over 20 chars gives 400. NRO/BEN online banking gets `isOnlineBankingAllowed=false`. Routing slip: insufficient balance, RS_NOT_ACTIVE, LINKED_ROUTING_SLIP each give 400; RS_DOESNT_EXIST gives 400 only if `ALLOW_LEGACY_ROUTING_SLIPS` false. Delete: draft invoice gives 202 even if PayBC down; completed gives 400. Partial refund requires invoice PAID (APPROVED gives 400, no RefundModel/RefundPartialModel created); success gives 202 with one RefundPartialModel per line. Transaction PATCH returns 200 with `paySystemReasonCode=SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` when PayBC unreachable; duplicate order number gives `DUPLICATE_ORDER_NUMBER`.

EFT shortname payment: missing `action` gives 400; unknown shortname gives 404. APPLY_CREDITS needs `accountId` (`EFT_PAYMENT_ACTION_ACCOUNT_ID_REQUIRED`) and sufficient credits (`EFT_INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS`); success gives 204, zeroes `remaining_amount`, creates PENDING credit-invoice links per `link_group_id`. CANCEL needs `accountId`; unexpected credit gives `EFT_CREDIT_AMOUNT_UNEXPECTED` with rollback. REVERSE needs `statementId` (`EFT_PAYMENT_ACTION_STATEMENT_ID_REQUIRED`); checks: links COMPLETED (`..._CREDIT_LINK_STATUS_INVALID`); invoice PAID (`..._UNPAID_STATEMENT`, `EFT_PAYMENT_INVOICE_REVERSE_UNEXPECTED_STATUS`); within 60 days (`..._REVERSAL_EXCEEDS_SIXTY_DAYS`); success gives 204, sends one `eft_service.send_email`, adds PENDING_REFUND link with same receipt/amount, restores credit. Consolidated EFT: `retryFailedPayment`, `payOutstandingBalance`, `allInvoiceStatuses` create `is_consolidated=True` references, cancel prior, call `CFSService.reverse_invoice` once. Statement settings default WEEKLY; POST changes it persistently; summary gives `totalDue`, `oldestDueDate`; `isEftUnderPayment` true when credit below invoice total. Bank verification always 200 with `isValid` and `message` list. CORS: OPTIONS answers 200 with `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`; `cors_preflight(methods)` adds `options()` method.

GOTCHA: Duplicate guard on APPLY_CREDITS only implied (PENDING links block re-application); no direct check visible. GOTCHA: Very large numeric id returns 500, not 404. GOTCHA: PAD/BCOL payment-method switches show no transactional guarantee; docstrings say 202 where assertions differ.

structured.condensed:
Scheduled back-office jobs that create and manage payment system accounts, invoices, receipts, and refunds by calling CFS, PayBC and Notify APIs, updating the pay DB, and uploading files to SFTP/Minio.

**In:** Pay-DB rows in pending states (CfsAccount, Invoice, RoutingSlip, Statement, EFT links), with optional date or account overrides.

**Out:** CFSService calls create/update accounts and receipts. OAuthService POSTs to PayBC direct-pay with Bearer token and distribution body `{revenue:[{lineNumber, revenueAccount, revenueAmount}]}`. Notify receives `{recipients, content{subject, body}}`. Mailer topic ACCOUNT_MAILER_TOPIC gets events PAD_INVOICE_CREATED, PAD_SETUP_FAILED, CONFIRMATION_PERIOD_OVER, PAYMENT_PENDING with source PAY_JOBS. EJV/AP files and `.trg` triggers upload to SFTP/Minio via `common/cgi_ejv.py` and `common/cgi_ap.py`.

**Entry points:** All are classmethods with no permission check shown.

**Main decisions:** `CfsCreateAccountTask.create_accounts` routes CASH/CHEQUE to `routing_slip.create_cfs_account`; others to `_create_cfs_account` (EFT uses `CFS_RCPT_EFT_WIRE`, existing party gets `update_bank_details`, new party created otherwise). Account status becomes PENDING_PAD_ACTIVATION if `pad_activation_date` future, else ACTIVE; on failure (checked via CAS-Returned-Messages header), PAD_SETUP_FAILED publishes and account becomes INACTIVE. `ActivatePadAccountTask` moves PENDING_PAD_ACTIVATION to ACTIVE when `pad_activation_date - 1h` passed; sets payment method PAD unless multiple-payment-methods flag on; publishes CONFIRMATION_PERIOD_OVER. `CreateInvoiceTask.create_invoices` processes PAD (skips FREEZE/non-ACTIVE accounts, aggregates APPROVED invoices, retries after 10s with `get_invoice` verify), online banking (sets SETTLEMENT_SCHEDULED if successful, skips unless `is_online_banking_allowed`), and routing slips (sets invoice PAID, creates COMPLETED InvoiceReference and Payment INTERNAL). `RoutingSlipTask.link_routing_slips`, `process_correction`, `process_void` call `InvoluntaryDissolutionService.check_business_eligibility`. `process_nsf` reverses receipt, marks payment FAILED, freezes account, resets invoices to CREATED, adds NSF fee. `adjust_routing_slips` zeroes receipts for REFUND_AUTHORIZED and WRITE_OFF_AUTHORIZED. `EftTask.link_electronic_funds_transfers_cfs` creates/applies CFS receipt then marks invoice PAID; `_create_receipt_and_invoice` raises LookupError without active InvoiceReference and reverses original (if count==0) for consolidated invoices; `reverse_electronic_funds_transfers_cfs` and `handle_unlinked_refund_requested_invoices` reverse on refund; `unlock_overdue_accounts` clears overdue flag when none remain. `EjvPaymentTask.create_ejv_file` takes APPROVED and REFUND_REQUESTED invoices without ACTIVE reference (REFUND_REQUESTED skipped if no COMPLETED InvoiceReference); decides GA vs GI by comparing distribution client to `CGI_BCREG_CLIENT_CODE`. `EjvPartnerDistributionTask` moves PAID invoices (not INTERNAL/DRAWDOWN/EFT) with disbursement None/ERRORED and age > `DISBURSEMENT_DELAY_IN_DAYS` to UPLOADED; reverses already-COMPLETED refunded invoices; skips distributions with `stop_ejv`. `ApTask` sends REFUND_AUTHORIZED routing slips to CHQ file (REFUND_UPLOADED), BCA non-gov in batches of 250, skips zero-value. `DirectPayAutomatedRefundTask` sets `gl_error` on RJCT/DECLINED, sets REFUNDED on PAID/REFUND_REQUESTED, sets REFUNDED plus `gl_posted` on CMPLT. `DistributionTask` re-POSTs when gl status not PAID/RJCT. `BcolRefundConfirmationTask` sets REFUNDED when `invoice.total + BCOL qty -1 == 0`, else raises Sentry error. `StatementTask.generate_statements` runs daily (always), weekly (Sunday), monthly (day 1), else gap; notification PENDING (or SKIP if date override given). `StatementNotificationTask` marks PENDING PROCESSING, SKIPs with no recipients, sends non-EFT via Notify, EFT via mailer only if flag `enable-eft-payment-method` on, else SKIP. `StatementDueTask.process_unpaid_statements` (flag-gated) sets EFT invoices past `overdue_date` to OVERDUE; action is OVERDUE/DUE (`to_date + 1 month`)/REMINDER (7 days before); OVERDUE publishes account-lock event and creates NSF records. `UnpaidInvoiceNotifyTask` produces PAYMENT_PENDING for ONLINE_BANKING unpaid after `NOTIFY_AFTER_DAYS`. `StalePaymentTask` updates stale transactions, deletes marked invoices, updates transaction for direct-pay invoices PayBC reports PAID/CMPLT.

**GOTCHA:** No permission check on any entry point. All jobs catch all exceptions per record, log to Sentry/logger, continue, and never retry—failures in mailer publish or Minio upload are silent. State changed before external success: EJV/AP flush `invoice.disbursement_status_code`, `rs.status`, InvoiceReference before SFTP; StatementDueTask saves `overdue_notification_date` before NSF step; EftTask uses flush only (partial update risk). No duplicate guard on receipts or EJV invoices. Statement task bulk-saves statements and invoice links separately. File names use only `time.sleep(1)` for collision avoidance.

uses.name: CFSService
uses.what: Calls to create accounts, invoices and receipts, apply or reverse receipts, update bank details

uses.name: routing_slip.create_cfs_account
uses.what: Called for CASH/CHEQUE payment methods to create account plus receipt

uses.name: _create_cfs_account
uses.what: Called for non-CASH/CHEQUE methods; creates account with CFS_RCPT_EFT_WIRE, updates existing, or creates new

uses.name: CAS-Returned-Messages
uses.what: HTTP header checked on CFS failure to determine user error for PAD_SETUP_FAILED

uses.name: OAuthService
uses.what: GET/POST to PayBC direct-pay payment URL with Bearer token; distribution POST body {revenue:[{lineNumber, revenueAccount, revenueAmount}]}

uses.name: NOTIFY_API_ENDPOINT
uses.what: OAuthService.post to endpoint+'notify/' with {recipients, content{subject, body}}

uses.name: utils/mailer.py
uses.what: Publishes to ACCOUNT_MAILER_TOPIC with source PAY_JOBS; event types PAD_INVOICE_CREATED, PAD_SETUP_FAILED, CONFIRMATION_PERIOD_OVER, PAYMENT_PENDING

uses.name: common/cgi_ejv.py
uses.what: EJV file and .trg trigger generation and upload to SFTP and Minio

uses.name: common/cgi_ap.py
uses.what: AP file generation with fixed-width formatting and SFTP upload to CGI

uses.name: get_invoice
uses.what: Called by CreateInvoiceTask to verify invoice after 10s retry on PAD error

uses.name: InvoluntaryDissolutionService.check_business_eligibility
uses.what: Called by RoutingSlipTask link_routing_slips, process_correction, process_void

uses.name: LookupError
uses.what: Raised by EftTask._create_receipt_and_invoice when no active invoice reference exists

uses.name: CGI_BCREG_CLIENT_CODE
uses.what: Configuration constant to decide GA vs GI in EjvPaymentTask

uses.name: DISBURSEMENT_DELAY_IN_DAYS
uses.what: Configuration constant for age threshold in EjvPartnerDistributionTask

uses.name: NOTIFY_AFTER_DAYS
uses.what: Configuration constant for unpaid invoice threshold in UnpaidInvoiceNotifyTask

uses.name: enable-eft-payment-method
uses.what: Flag to gate EFT mailer sending in StatementNotificationTask

uses.name: multiple-payment-methods
uses.what: Flag to gate setting payment method to PAD in ActivatePadAccountTask

uses.name: Sentry
uses.what: Exception logging and error reporting for record-level failures and BcolRefundConfirmationTask mismatches

uses.name: logger
uses.what: Logs all per-record exceptions

uses.name: pad_activation_date
uses.what: Field determining PENDING_PAD_ACTIVATION status and activation timing

uses.name: overdue_date
uses.what: Field for EFT invoice overdue determination in StatementDueTask

uses.name: overdue_notification_date
uses.what: Field saved before NSF step in StatementDueTask

uses.name: invoice.disbursement_status_code
uses.what: Flushed before SFTP upload in EJV/AP tasks

uses.name: rs.status
uses.what: Flushed before SFTP upload in EJV/AP tasks

uses.name: InvoiceReference
uses.what: Created as COMPLETED during invoice payment and flushed before SFTP

uses.name: time.sleep
uses.what: Called for 1-second collision avoidance in file naming

structured.condensed:
Front-end support layer for a business-filings Vue/TypeScript app. Supplies mixins for permissions, filing construction and navigation; static API clients for Auth, Legal and Pay services; date and enum utilities; LaunchDarkly feature-flag wrapper; office-address validation schema.

Inbound: Components and stores call mixins for allowed actions, filing payloads (CorrectionFilingIF, DissolutionFilingIF, RestorationFilingIF), navigation, validation. Entry points include `isAllowed(action)`, `updateFilingData(code)`, `navigateToBusinessDashboard()`, `validateAndScroll()`, `directorWarning()`. No authorization checks shown; `isAllowed` only reports store and flag state, callers enforce access.

Outbound: Auth API (GET entities/{id}/authorizations, users/@me, entities/{id}, affiliationInvitations with params {toOrgId, businessIdentifier, statuses:'PENDING'}, PATCH affiliationInvitations/{id}/authorization/{accept|refuse}). Legal API (GET businesses/{id}, /tasks, /filings, /addresses, /parties?role=, nameRequests/{nr}/validate?phone=&email=, documents/{file}/signatures presigned URL, PUT with x-amz-meta-userid, x-amz-meta-key, Content-Disposition headers, digitalCredentials routes). Pay API (GET codes/errors/{code}, accounts/{id} returning cfsAccount.cfsAccountNumber). LaunchDarkly (InitLdClient with anonymous user, UpdateLdUser calls identify, GetFeatureFlag returns variation or defaultFlagSet[name]). Router navigation.

Decisions: `isAllowed(action)` switches on action name—combines `isAllowedFiling` (store's getAllowedActions.filing.filingTypes filtered by name/type) with LaunchDarkly flags, adds `isRoleStaff` for DETAIL_COMMENT and STAFF_COMMENT, requires sessionStorage.BUSINESS_ID for BUSINESS_SUMMARY, routes Firms' ADDRESS_CHANGE/DIRECTOR_CHANGE/BUSINESS_INFORMATION to CHANGE_OF_REGISTRATION. `updateFilingData(code)` replaces entry for given code; no code sets priority/waiveFees on all entries. `buildDissolutionFiling` sets custodialOffice to getBusinessAddress||null for SOLE_PROP/PARTNERSHIP, registered office for others. `navigateToBusinessDashboard` checks use-business-dashboard flag: true→navigate(dashUrl/identifier?filing_id=), false→router.push Routes.DASHBOARD. `validateAndScroll` scrolls first invalid component, skips top-scroll under Vitest. `directorWarning` returns first failing check: bcResident, canadianResident (>50% non-CA), minDirectors (non-ceased count), using DIRECTOR_CHANGE_BC or DIRECTOR_CHANGE_OT from isBaseCompany. `EnumUtilities` provides 60+ boolean classifiers on status, name, filingSubType, restoration.type, dissolution.dissolutionType, amalgamationApplication.type; `isTypeStaff` covers staff-only filings, filingTypeToName/dissolutionTypeToName map to names (firms get DISSOLUTION_FIRM). `hasPendingTasks` returns true if any task's filing status ≠ NEW. `fetchNameRequest` returns null on 404, throws on 400/403. Office-address schema requires country='CA', region='BC', enforces maxLength.

Failure handling: Legal digital-credential methods catch all errors, console.log and return null. fetchDocument and other fetches log to console. PayServices.getPayErrorObj swallows errors, returns undefined. fetchCfsAccountId logs and rethrows. AuthServices has no retry beyond axios defaults. UpdateLdUser swallows errors; InitLdClient closes client on failure. navigateToBusinessDashboard swallows router errors. No mutation before a failing step; FilingMixin mutates store only.

GOTCHA: DateUtilities.compareYyyyMmDd passes operator argument to eval() unsanitized. GOTCHA: DateUtilities.getServerDate() falls back to browser local clock on any HEAD-request error, can stamp filings with wrong date. GOTCHA: Legal and digital-credential call errors return null or log only, so callers cannot distinguish failure from "no data".

structured.condensed:
Unit tests for two legal-api v2 read endpoints: `GET /api/v2/businesses/{id}/filings/{filing_id}/documents` returns a documents object with receipt URL, legalFilings array, and conditional certificate/notice keys; `GET /api/v2/businesses/{id}/filings` returns a ledger array with 16 keys per filing.

**Documents endpoint flow:** Path carries business id and filing id. JWT header includes roles and identifier. Status PAPER_ONLY or PENDING returns 404. PAID returns receipt (POST to payment service at `{PAYMENT_SVC_URL}/{payment_token}/receipts`) plus legalFilings. COMPLETED adds certificates and noticeOfArticles except for certain types. Conversion returns empty documents. Temp-business COMPLETED returns empty; others in AWAITING_REVIEW, CHANGE_REQUESTED, APPROVED, REJECTED return receipt plus legalFilings. continuationIn builds director-affidavit and authorization-file from _meta_data; shape depends on payment-date presence. changeOfRegistration COMPLETED adds amendedRegistrationStatement. CP correction adds certifiedRules. Receipt sub-endpoint `GET .../documents/receipt` with `accept: application/pdf` calls payment service once.

**Ledger flow:** Only completed filings appear. Output keys: availableOnPaperOnly, effectiveDate, filingId, name, paymentStatusCode, status, submittedDate, submitter, displayLedger, commentsCount, data.order (court-order fields), filingSubType (restoration subtypes). Display names: annualReport becomes "Annual Report (YYYY)"; correction shown as "Correction - <type>"; specialResolution as "Special Resolution"; changeOfAddress as "Address Change"; incorporation entity-type specific; unknown types title-cased. Submitter redaction by JWT role: Staff/system/public see firstname+lastname or "Registry Staff"; unknown roles see username or empty string. commentsCount from filing.comments. Corrections link via parent_filing_id and correctedFilingId.

**Decisions:** filer_action helper fills _meta_data per filing name—alteration adds fromLegalName/toLegalName; continuationIn adds affidavitFileKey/authorization.files; CP correction adds name change, uploadNewRules, uploadNewMemorandum, hasResolution.

**Checks:** Auth enforces role via JWT (test_not_authorized expects 401 for "SOME RANDO ROLE"). Missing business, wrong filing id, unpaid filing return 404. No check shown inside endpoint; temp tests mock has_roles() to true.

**GOTCHA:** Test IDs cben_cont_in_completed, c_cont_in_completed, cul_cont_in_completed appear twice with different payloads—parametrize collision may hide cases. Tests bypass real status transitions by setting skip_status_listener=True and writing _status/_payment_completion_date/_meta_data directly. Payment-service call shows no retry, error or warning handling. Test IDs normalized by regex could allow wrong filing id to slip through.

structured.condensed:
Flask routing layer for legal-api v1/v2 HTTP endpoints and v2 admin/BN endpoints; reads Business, Configuration, Review and RequestTracker models; publishes to NATS and calls namex.

**Entry points:** `/api/v2/...` routes; staff and admin callers send JWT. `before_request` uses `accept-version` header to route to API_V1 or API_V2 endpoints; V2 paths with no V2 endpoint redirect to V1 (302/permanent) with CORS headers. `after_request` adds `API` and `SCHEMAS` version headers.

**BN requests** (`administrative_bn.create_bn_request`): unknown business returns 400 "A valid business is required"; otherwise publishes `BN15` entity event as CloudEvent (specversion='1.x-wip', type='bc.registry.admin.bn', source=LEGAL_API_BASE_URL/{identifier}, id=uuid4 or caller message_id, time) with data={header:{request, businessNumber}, business:{identifier}} to NATS_ENTITY_EVENT_SUBJECT.

**Request tracker** POST: creates RequestTracker (retry_number=-1, is_admin=True), saves, publishes RESUBMIT_<request_type.name>. GET list: non-GET_BN BN_HUB records; GET by id returns request_object, response_object, json.

**Reviews** POST `/reviews/<id>`: current status must be AWAITING_REVIEW or RESUBMITTED (else 400); new status in [CHANGE_REQUESTED, APPROVED, REJECTED] (else 400); comment required for CHANGE_REQUESTED/REJECTED (else 400). Creates ReviewResult, sets review.status, calls `filing.set_review_decision(status_mapping)`. Publishes emailer (NATS_EMAILER_SUBJECT: {email:{filingId, type, option:filing.status}}) and filer (NATS_FILER_SUBJECT: {filing:{id}}) only if filing.status=APPROVED and effective_date≤now(UTC). No retry on queue publish.

**Reviews** GET list: builds ReviewFilter from query params; `get_mapped_column` maps camelCase sort keys to columns; queries NR expiry (via namex.query_nr_numbers) only for CHANGE_REQUESTED, AWAITING_REVIEW, RESUBMITTED rows. GET by id builds filingLink.

**Configuration** PUT: uppercases names; rejects empty list/duplicates/non-existent names; validates value types via `Configuration.validate_configuration_value`; NUM_DISSOLUTIONS_ALLOWED must not exceed MAX_DISSOLUTIONS_ALLOWED (via `find_config_by_name`); violations return 400 with rollback. GET: all configs or case-insensitive comma-separated `names` filter; malformed names return 400, no match return 404.

**Dissolution** `/dissolutions/statistics`: returns `eligibleCount` from `InvoluntaryDissolutionService.get_businesses_eligible_count()`.

**Guards:** staff via `@jwt.has_one_of_roles` on reviews/configurations/dissolution; `admin_edit` or `bn_edit` on administrative_bn and request_tracker; meta.info GET shows no check.

**Publish failures:** entity-event captured to Sentry, logged, re-raised; BusinessException re-raised; other errors logged. ReviewResult, review status and filing committed before emailer/filer publish; failed publish leaves decided review with no email or filing job. No check that filing exists. Version header values not validated. Redirect logic duplicated.

Exposes business data, filings, comments, name-request proxies and cron endpoints via Flask-RESTX routing (v1 at `/api/v1` and `/ops`, v2 at `/api/v2`), delegating to models, payment service, namex, MinIO, account service and RegistrationBootstrapService.

**Entry points:** Business routes (`/businesses/<identifier>/...`), filing lifecycle, tasks, directors, comments; internal routes for tax IDs and COLIN updates; name-request validation. Auth: `@jwt.requires_auth` plus `authorized()` for view/add_comment/edit actions (401); `COLIN_SVC_ROLE` for internal endpoints; public: aliases, `/meta/info`, `/ops/healthz`, `/readyz`, nr_type_map.

**Filing flow:** POST validates incorporation/registration type (else 400), creates RegistrationBootstrap or delegates to PUT. PUT checks authorization, saves to bootstrap or Business. `complete_filing` queues COLIN (copying epoch transaction_id for pre-epoch filings) or invokes `_create_invoice` then `_set_effective_date`. Invoice (POST to `PAYMENT_SVC_URL` with Bearer token) returns 402 on 400 status, timeout or any other error; only logs failures. `_set_effective_date` uses header `futureEffectiveDate` for incorporation/registration, tomorrow 00:01 for non-COOP changeOfAddress. DELETE refuses if `deletion_locked` or payment exists, deletes from MinIO and bootstrap. PATCH deletes payment via `DELETE {PAYMENT_SVC_URL}/{payment_token}` (20s timeout), resets to DRAFT on 200/202.

**Tasks:** NRs validated via `namex.validate_nr` (403 if not consumable); todos are filings in DRAFT/PENDING/PENDING_CORRECTION/ERROR plus annual-report todos per year. **Name-request validation:** affiliated account returns namex JSON, else `email` or `phone` must match applicant (403 if neither, 400 on mismatch). **Directors:** COOP mailing stripped; active as of `date` param. **Fee logic:** `_get_filing_types` per type; changeOfDirectors with only name/address changes is free.

GOTCHA: `ColinLastUpdate.post` builds INSERT with unparameterized f-string (SQL injection) and syntax error in except clause. `InternalFilings.patch` saves once per colin_id in loop—partial update on failure. `_save_filing` lacks transaction safety. Bootstrap rollback is commented TODO. `filing_comments` POST returns CREATED/ACCEPTED for errors. `_create_invoice` uses `mailing_address` without null check. Missing business in `/internal/tax_ids` POST only logged, returns 201. Bootstrap creation failure deletes bootstrap under `suppress(Exception)`. `_check_and_update_nr` extends expired name requests without documented guard.

structured.condensed: Test-side notes for the entity-emailer queue service, which turns queue events into email dicts and sends them through worker.send_email. Entry point: `worker.process_email(event, token)` dispatches CloudEvents or `{filingId, type, option}` payloads to processor modules (filing_notification, special_resolution_notification, correction_notification, etc.), which return `{recipients, content: {subject, body, attachments[]}}`. The token comes from `AccountService.get_bearer_token`; this chunk shows no authorization check on it. Processors fetch PDFs via `_get_pdfs(status, token, business, filing)` (mocked in tests) from Legal API or Pay API, look up recipients and name requests via auth and name services, and base64-encode attachments. Subject and recipients vary by status (PAID, COMPLETED, REJECTED, etc.) and filing type; submitter role, firms, and numbered companies trigger special recipient rules. Furnishing status moves to PROCESSED on valid send or FAILED on `EmailException`, which is re-raised; other failures are not recorded. `send_email` enforces a payload check (recipients, body, content, requestBy present) and raises `QueueException` on failure. GOTCHA: no duplicate-send guard shown; processor legal-name selection by state has no fallback shown; `_get_pdfs` or auth-lookup failures are not handled in noted processors; FAILED status recorded only for `EmailException`.

Test suite for entity-emailer queue service that exercises message processing, tracking and event publishing against a real database and NATS/STAN.

**In:** CloudEvents-style STAN messages with `specversion '1.x-wip'`, `type`, `source`, `data`. Types: `bc.registry.names.request`, `bc.registry.dissolution`, `bc.registry.affiliation`, `bc.registry.bnmove`, and email events (incorporationApplication, annualReport, agmLocationChange, agmExtension, alteration, dissolution, registration, changeOfRegistration, consentContinuationOut, continuationOut, specialResolution, correction, amalgamationApplication) where `data.email` holds `type`, `option`, `filingId`.

**Out:** `publish_event({'email': {'type': 'bn'}})` to `APP_CONFIG.ENTITY_EVENT_PUBLISH_OPTIONS['subject']` via ServiceWorker on `entity_stan`. **Tracking:** `MessageProcessing` record with `message_id`, `status`, `message_seen_count`, `last_update`, `last_error`.

**Main flow:** `process_email` succeeds → status = `COMPLETE` (tested for all types including `amalgamationApplication_COMPLETED_111222335`); `COMPLETE` messages skip reprocessing. `QueueException`/`EmailException` → status = `FAILED`, `last_error` recorded; `EmailException` re-raised, `QueueException` swallowed; error strings: `QueueException, Exception - <message>` or `QueueException, Exception`. `FAILED` retries on redelivery, max 6 attempts; after cap, no retry, status stays `FAILED`.

**Decision:** None shown. **Mocks:** `worker.process_email`, no real email sent. **DB state:** Savepoint-rollback session; rebuilt by dropping and running `legal-api` Alembic migrations. **Factories:** `prep_alteration_filing` hardcodes `'legalype'` (not `'legalType'`); `prep_maintenance_filing` references undefined `FILING_TYPE_MAPPER`. **Hazards:** Hardcoded emails and bootstrap IDs (`Tb31yQIuBw`, `BC1234567`); unvalidated `_meta_data` writes can collide outside rollback. Integration test waits max 2 seconds for published message; `helper_add_filing_to_queue` publishes JSON with no error handling. Skip tests unless `RUN_COLIN_API` set.
