structured.condensed: Alembic revision scripts that evolve the legal-api Postgres schema through migrations, applied in `down_revision` order with no external service calls. Each revision adds, removes or renames columns on filings, businesses, directors, party_roles, batch_processing and users tables; creates tables for registration_bootstrap, colin_last_update, colin_event_ids, comments and sent_to_gazette; and establishes foreign keys linking directors to addresses, party_roles to filings, and batch_processing to filings. Key decision: `7c86cc916b5c` sets filings.source to 'COLIN' or 'LEAR' based on colin_event_id and filing_type. Another: `92c4974ce96f` moves colin_event_id values into colin_event_ids table then drops the column on upgrade, reversing on downgrade but losing data where multiple event_ids pointed to one filing. The manual script `2022_jan_31_add_ar_filing_year_to_meta_data.sql` backfills meta_data.annualReport.annualReportFilingYear from annualReportDate (COLIN) or businesses_version.last_ar_year (LEAR), running in an explicit transaction with COMMIT and ROLLBACK commented out for manual execution. Most migrations are plain column add/drop on nullable columns with no backfill and no validation or authorization checks. Most unnamed foreign keys depend on Postgres defaults; only batch_processing_filing_id_fkey is explicit. Nullable columns added do not backfill existing rows; code must tolerate NULLs. GOTCHA: `92c4974ce96f` downgrade is data-losing. GOTCHA: `94c2a694d51f` docstring cites `176f983485c8` but down_revision is `0fb2ae5711ed`; the chain follows down_revision. GOTCHA: manual SQL script requires explicit manual COMMIT or ROLLBACK after review.

uses.what: revision execution order determined by down_revision chain; Alembic applies each revision to evolve schema.

uses.what: joined on business_id and transaction_id to backfill last_ar_year into meta_data in manual script 2022_jan_31_add_ar_filing_year_to_meta_data.sql; no credential or check shown.

uses.name: ORM models (filings, businesses, directors, party_roles, comments)
uses.what: read and write the resulting columns and tables after migrations apply; no authorization check in migrations.

structured.condensed: The pay-api service layer creates and manages invoices, payments, refunds and accounts, delegating each payment to an adapter (PayBC/CFS, BCOL, Direct Pay, PAD, EJV, internal routing slip, online banking, deposit/EFT stub) and publishing events to GCP PubSub. Input: `payment_request` dict with businessInfo, filingInfo, accountInfo, paymentInfo.methodOfPayment to `PaymentService.create_invoice`/`update_invoice`; redirect callbacks to `PaymentTransaction.update_transaction`; account requests to `PaymentAccount.create`/`update`. Output: `gcp_queue_publisher.publish_to_queue(QueueMessage(...))` with CloudEvent source `sbc-pay-{source}`, silently returns if topic is None, no failure handling. Payloads are camelized `PaymentToken`, `REFUND_DRAWDOWN_REQUEST`, account events. HTTP via `OAuthService.post/get` (wraps all calls, connection/5xx errors → `ServiceUnavailableException`, 404 retry up to 5 times, no other retry). Decision flow: `PaymentSystemFactory.create` routes by fees, user role, account state (total_fees==0 → Internal; STAFF/SYSTEM with bcolAccountNumber → BCOL else Internal; else method-based, raises INVALID_CORP_OR_FILING_TYPE or ACCOUNT_IN_PAD_CONFIRMATION_PERIOD). `PaymentService.create_invoice` checks enable-eft-payment-method flag (off → INVALID_PAYMENT_METHOD), flushes invoice/line items, calls pay_service, commits, runs `complete_post_invoice`, on failure rolls back and re-raises. `update_invoice` applies credit from account (full/partial) or only switches ONLINE_BANKING to CC/DIRECT_PAY, else INVALID_REQUEST. `delete_invoice` checks PAID/DELETED/APPROVED/pending-payments via `_check_if_invoice_can_be_deleted` (raises COMPLETED_PAYMENT), cancels in pay system, marks deleted. `accept_delete` requires EDIT_ROLE, runs in thread. `PaymentTransaction.update_transaction` refuses if COMPLETED; re-publishes COMPLETED only when EVENT_FAILED; calls `get_receipt` on pay system (no receipt → FAILED, else `_update_receipt_details` and unlock frozen). `create_transaction_for_invoice` refuses PAD, cancels existing, validates redirect URL for CC/DIRECT_PAY. `publish_status` sends COMPLETED event only if invoice PAID, else TRANSACTION_FAILED. `PaymentSystemService.complete_payment` sets payment COMPLETED, invoice PAID, reference COMPLETED, creates Receipt; `_release_payment` skips CSO/RPT/PPR/VS and swallows publish errors. `ensure_no_payment_blockers` checks PAD_CURRENTLY_NSF or EFT_INVOICES_OVERDUE. Sandbox decorators bypass downstream. Refunds: Direct Pay needs PAID or UPDATE_REVENUE_ACCOUNT invoice, POSTs to PayBC; Internal rejects zero-total and non-ACTIVE/COMPLETE slips, credits slip; EJV non-billable → REFUNDED, APPROVED → CANCELLED/REFUND_REQUESTED, PAID → REFUND_REQUESTED; PAD/online banking create credit memo (CREDITED if APPROVED with active reference, else CANCELLED); BCOL publishes to mailer. `InternalPayService._validate_routing_slip` raises RS_DOESNT_EXIST/RS_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS/RS_NOT_ACTIVE or parent/amount errors, sets slip COMPLETE when remaining_amount < 0.01. `PaymentAccount.delete_account` refuses on credit > 0 (OUTSTANDING_CREDIT), FREEZE (FROZEN_ACCOUNT), or open transactions (TRANSACTIONS_IN_PROGRESS); `create` raises ACCOUNT_EXISTS; `_check_and_handle_payment_method` blocks EFT transitions. `unlock_frozen_accounts` resets PAD receipt method, clears NSF/overdue, sets ACTIVE. `PaymentLineItem.create` requires STAFF role for waived fees (FEE_OVERRIDE_NOT_ALLOWED). `Invoice.find_by_id` runs `check_auth` (skippable via `skip_auth_check`). `auth.check_auth` aborts 403 on role/premium failure. `Statement.generate_interim_statement` and `StatementSettings.update_statement_settings` handle frequency. No permission check shown in most entry points; role checks only in `check_auth`, `accept_delete`, `PaymentLineItem.create`, bank-info masking. CFS uses Bearer token from `CFSService.get_token()` (PAYBC/FAS via Basic auth), BCOL uses user token, report-api/auth-api use user token. `create_invoice` commits before `complete_post_invoice`. GOTCHA: `_save_account` flushes before CFS step; `PadService.update_account` deactivates old before creating new—failure leaves half-built account. GOTCHA: `complete_payment` only flushes Receipt/Payment; later failure may leave invoice/reference unsaved. Queue publish failures logged only; `publish_status` sets EVENT_FAILED. GOTCHA: `CFSService._create_site` silently reuses on 400. GOTCHA: `adjust_receipt_to_zero` does not check POST result. GOTCHA: `delete_invoice` via thread skips auth. GOTCHA: `refund.get_refund_partials_by_payment_line_item_id` missing join.

uses.name: gcp_queue_publisher.publish_to_queue
uses.what: CloudEvent with source sbc-pay-{source}, QueueMessage containing PaymentToken (camelized), REFUND_DRAWDOWN_REQUEST, or account events to per-corp-type topic or ACCOUNT_MAILER_TOPIC/AUTH_EVENT_TOPIC; silent return if topic None, no failure handling

uses.name: OAuthService.post
uses.what: HTTP POST to CFS/PayBC, BCOL, report-api, auth-api with user or CFS Bearer token; connection errors and 5xx raise ServiceUnavailableException

uses.name: OAuthService.get
uses.what: HTTP GET to CFS/PayBC, BCOL, report-api, auth-api with user or CFS Bearer token; connection errors and 5xx raise ServiceUnavailableException; retries 404 up to 5 times

uses.name: CFSService.get_token
uses.what: Fetches Bearer token for CFS calls via PAYBC or FAS client credentials (Basic auth)

uses.name: enable-eft-payment-method
uses.what: Feature flag; if off, EFT payment raises INVALID_PAYMENT_METHOD

uses.name: ACCOUNT_MAILER_TOPIC
uses.what: GCP topic for account lifecycle events published via publish_to_queue

uses.name: AUTH_EVENT_TOPIC
uses.what: GCP topic for auth events published via publish_to_queue

uses.name: PayBC/CFS
uses.what: HTTP calls for invoice/payment creation, refunds, receipt retrieval, credit memos, routing slip operations; uses Bearer token from CFSService.get_token()

uses.name: BCOL
uses.what: HTTP calls for BCOL-routed payments and refunds; uses user's Bearer token

uses.name: report-api
uses.what: HTTP calls for statement and report operations; uses user's Bearer token

uses.name: auth-api
uses.what: HTTP calls for role and permission checks; used by check_auth and premium validation

structured.condensed:
Calculates and stores fee schedules, distribution codes, and code lookups for the pay-api service layer, sitting between API resources and database models.

Entry points: API resources call static or class methods (`find_all`, `find_by_id`, `save_or_update`, `find_by_corp_type_and_filing_type`); no checks shown. Outputs: dicts shaped for marshmallow schemas—`{codes: [...]}` for codes, `{items: [...]}` for fee schedules, schema dumps for distribution codes.

Code lookup decision (`find_code_values_by_type`): checks `cache.get(code_type)`; on miss, queries ErrorCode, InvoiceStatusCode, CorpType, FeeCode, or RoutingSlipStatusCode models, dumps rows via schema, calls `cache.set`. Single code lookup filters cached list matching `cd.get("type")` or `cd.get("code")`.

Fee lookup (`find_by_corp_type_and_filing_type`): raises `BusinessException(Error.INVALID_CORP_OR_FILING_TYPE)` if corp or filing type missing or not found. Account fee override: loads `AccountFeeModel` by account_id and corp type; if `apply_filing_fees` is false, zeroes `fee_amount` and `waived_fee_amount`. Priority and future-effective fees added only when flagged and `apply_filing_fees` true. Service fees: result is 0 for staff and system users with `EXCLUDE_SERVICE_FEES` role, or when `fee.amount` not above 0 or no `service_fee` set; otherwise fetched from `FeeCodeModel.find_by_code()`.

Distribution code save (`save_or_update(distribution_details, dist_id=None)`): creates or loads record, parses startDate (default UTC now) and endDate, detects changes to client, responsibility_centre, service_line, project_code, service_fee_distribution_code_id. If changed and `dist_id` set, calls `InvoiceModel.update_invoices_for_revenue_updates(dist_id)`. Updates all `DistributionCodeModel.find_by_service_fee_distribution_id()` entries, sets `stop_ejv=False`, saves, returns schema dump. Bulk-links via `DistributionCodeLinkModel` per fee schedule.

GOTCHA: No permission or authorization checks in code.py, distribution_code.py, or fee lookups. No error handling shown around database calls. `save_or_update` does not show commit before invoice update; partial failure not recorded. Setter persistence: `service_fee_name`, `service_fee_stob`, `service_fee_line`, `service_fee_project_code` setters change only in-memory fields, not `_dao`; edits not persisted by `save()`. Fees ignored by quantity: quantity scales only `fee_amount`, not priority or future-effective fees. `asdict()` hardcodes `processing_fees` to 0.

Vue components for managing an organization's account settings (info, login options, payment methods, statements, transactions, API keys, product packages), delegating writes to Pinia stores that call backend services. Entry points are routed through Pinia; UI-only permission checks with `v-can` hide buttons but lack backend enforcement.

**Inputs & outputs:** Props down, `update:*` events up to parent `AccountInfo`. Store calls return organization, access type, payments, statements, transactions, API keys and products. Decisions: `updateDetails` diffs fields so only changes are sent; a 409 (duplicate name) shows specific error, others generic. `updateAndSaveAccessTypeDetails` calls `removeOrgAccountFees` only for `REGULAR` type. `confirmSuspendAccount` validates reason form and checks status becomes `SUSPENDED` before opening completion dialog. `AccountAccessType` requires `PREMIUM` org, type in [REGULAR, EXTRA_PROVINCIAL, REGULAR_BCEID, GOVN] and permission to enable change button; switching to `REGULAR` unconfirmed opens confirmation modal. `AccountDetails.canOrgChange` checks `nameChangeAllowed && viewOnlyMode && !isGovnGovmOrg`. `AccountBusinessType` validates name always, type and size for business/government; selects government codes if `isGovnAccount`. `AccountPaymentMethods.initialize` redirects unless `Permission.VIEW_PAYMENT_METHODS` or `MAKE_PAYMENT` held; `getCreateRequestBody` branches by method (PAD, BCOL, EJV need specific fields); `verifyPAD` calls `validatePADInfo`; EFT `save` calls `syncActiveOrgMembers` for non-User members and enables statement notifications; 409/400 shows `response.data.message`. `Statements` and `Transactions` redirect unless staff/SBC staff or `PREMIUM` org with Admin/Coordinator membership. `exportCSV` shows "max exceeded" on `BAD_REQUEST`, else basic error. `ProductPackage` maps `PENDING_STAFF_REVIEW`, `REJECTED` to messages, `ACTIVE` to none; requires ≥1 selected product. `StatementsSettings.updateSettings` saves only changed fields; `OrgAdminContact` lists admins only or usernames for `ANONYMOUS` access type.

**Permission gates:** `Permission.CHANGE_ADDRESS`, `Role.StaffSuspendAccounts` (ACTIVE/SUSPENDED only), `Role.StaffManageAccounts`.

**GOTCHA:** `v-can` directives only hide UI; no backend authorization on emit or save paths. Unguarded entry points: `ExistingAPIKeys` (list/revoke), `AccountSettingsLoginOption.submit`, `StatementsSettings.openSettings`, `AccountPaymentMethods.save`, `OrgAdminContact`. `getOrgApiKeys`, `revokeOrgApiKeys`, `ProductPackage.submitProductRequest`, `ProductPackage.saveProductFee` errors only console-logged or logged, no retry. `Statements.downloadStatement` marks download in `sessionStorage[StatementsDownloaded]` in `finally`, so failed downloads marked as done. EFT `save`: failed `updateStatementNotifications` unhandled after `updateOrg` commits payment method.

structured.condensed:
Holds the Alembic setup and revision chain that builds and evolves the legal-api Postgres schema. It takes work from the Flask-Migrate CLI (`flask db upgrade/migrate`) and hands changes to the database only. It calls no other service, queue or email.

**Input:** `SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI` from Flask config and model metadata from `current_app.extensions['migrate'].db.metadata`. **Output:** DDL and data statements run against the database, one revision at a time.

**Flow:** `env.py` runs offline (URL only) or online (live connection), both calling `context.run_migrations()` inside `context.begin_transaction()`. `process_revision_directives` skips an autogenerate revision when `config.cmd_opts.autogenerate` detects no schema change, logging "No changes in schema detected".

**Revisions:** Root `98ccc973c01d` (down_revision=None) creates businesses, users, transactions, filings and `*_version` audit tables following SQLAlchemy-Continuum (each versioned table has `transaction_id`, `end_transaction_id`, `operation_type`). Subsequent revisions add: offices with types registeredOffice, recordsOffice, custodialOffice, businessOffice; dissolution batches with QUEUED status, max_size, trigger_date, meta_data and sequence `batch_custom_identifier` starting 100000; configurations table seeding dissolution settings, later rewritten to stage 1/2/3 schedules, then removing DISSOLUTIONS_ON_HOLD and DISSOLUTIONS_SUMMARY_EMAIL; furnishings, xml_payloads, furnishing_groups with address link migrations and grouping_identifier removal; reviews, review_results, filings.resubmission_date; digital credentials tables and enums with revocation columns and credential_id resize; amalgamation tables with foreign_jurisdiction_region and foreign_identifier renaming; user idp_userid uniqueness, 34 indexes, resolution field widened to TEXT, business_identifier_coop sequence starting 1002395.

**No entry point has authorization check.** No retry, no custom error handling. Duplicate guards absent except enum creation with `checkfirst=True` and office inserts.

**GOTCHA:** `94586877d4bc` has no-op downgrade for corp_types, leaving data changed after rollback. `5e1faa8636c0` creates `addresses_office_id_fkey_new` in upgrade but recreates as `addresses_office_id_fk` in downgrade, drifting constraint name from original. `e85053684b3c` passes `None` as unique constraint name, database-generated name cannot be reliably recreated. `f4f93ea8887e` seeds rows with raw `op.execute()`, not transactional with table creation.

uses.name: Flask-Migrate CLI
uses.what: flask db upgrade/migrate commands invoke the migration chain via Alembic, no check shown

uses.name: SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI
uses.what: Flask config key providing the database connection string for online or offline runs

{"condensed":"Holds the Alembic setup and revision chain that builds and evolves the legal-api Postgres schema. It takes work from the Flask-Migrate CLI (`flask db upgrade/migrate`) and hands changes to the database only. It calls no other service, queue or email.

**Input:** `SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI` from Flask config and model metadata from `current_app.extensions['migrate'].db.metadata`. **Output:** DDL and data statements run against the database, one revision at a time.

**Flow:** `env.py` runs offline (URL only) or online (live connection), both calling `context.run_migrations()` inside `context.begin_transaction()`. `process_revision_directives` skips an autogenerate revision when `config.cmd_opts.autogenerate` detects no schema change, logging "No changes in schema detected".

**Revisions:** Root `98ccc973c01d` (down_revision=None) creates businesses, users, transactions, filings and `*_version` audit tables following SQLAlchemy-Continuum (each versioned table has `transaction_id`, `end_transaction_id`, `operation_type`). Subsequent revisions add: offices with types registeredOffice, recordsOffice, custodialOffice, businessOffice; dissolution batches with QUEUED status, max_size, trigger_date, meta_data and sequence `batch_custom_identifier` starting 100000; configurations table seeding dissolution settings, later rewritten to stage 1/2/3 schedules, then removing DISSOLUTIONS_ON_HOLD and DISSOLUTIONS_SUMMARY_EMAIL; furnishings, xml_payloads, furnishing_groups with address link migrations and grouping_identifier removal; reviews, review_results, filings.resubmission_date; digital credentials tables and enums with revocation columns and credential_id resize; amalgamation tables with foreign_jurisdiction_region and foreign_identifier renaming; user idp_userid uniqueness, 34 indexes, resolution field widened to TEXT, business_identifier_coop sequence starting 1002395.

An OpenAPI 3.0.1 contract documenting the BC Registries business API (`/business/api/v2`) with no logic or enforcement; it specifies what clients may call and what responses they receive.

Callers send requests with `x-apikey` header (BC Registries API key) and `accountId` query parameter (or Account-Id header). The spec declares `jwt` scheme (oauth2 password flow with empty URLs and no scopes).

Entry points (no authorization checks shown in this spec):
- `GET /businesses/{identifier}`: returns Business; 401 if user not linked to business, 404 if not found.
- `POST /businesses`: creates new business entity (Incorporation Application, Amalgamation variants, Continuation In, Registration); returns 201 with JSON. Query flags: `draft` (save as Draft), `only_validate` (validate without creating).
- `GET /businesses/{identifier}/filings`: returns filing Ledger as JSON.
- `POST /businesses/{identifier}/filings`: submits Filing schema; returns 201 or 422 (missing required fields). Same `draft` and `only_validate` flags.
- `GET /businesses/{identifier}/addresses`: returns Office schema with current addresses; 401 or 404.
- `GET /businesses/{identifier}/parties`: returns Incorporator, Completing Party, Directors.
- `GET /businesses/search`: autocomplete with `q` (min length 1); returns Solr-style suggestions (numFound, suggestions with term and weight).
- `GET /businesses/{identifier}/{documentName}`: retrieves documents (summary, cogs, cstat, lseal); Accept header selects PDF (bytes) or JSON.

All responses carry CORS headers (Access-Control-Allow-Origin, -Methods, -Headers, -Max-Age).

Draft vs. validate-only vs. real submission determined solely by `draft` and `only_validate` query flags. No state transitions, retries, or error recording documented.

GOTCHA: This chunk shows no authorization checks—the spec declares only that 401 means "user not linked to business," but enforces nothing. The `jwt` scheme defines empty token and refresh URLs with no scopes, blocking token discovery. Several response schemas and request bodies are marked incomplete.

structured.condensed: Documents Alembic migration history for auth-api and legal-api databases, plus generated schema docs (SchemaSpy, Graphviz, Business API YAML). Migrations apply DDL and seed data via CLI (`manage.py db upgrade`, `flask db upgrade`). Entry point: CLI invokes `env.py`, which reads DB URL and model metadata from Flask app. `include_object` drops tables in `SKIPPED_MIGRATIONS`. `process_revision_directives` skips empty autogenerates. `script.py.mako` templates revision files. Alembic walks `down_revision` chains executing `upgrade()` or `downgrade()`; merge revisions are empty stubs. `alembic_version` records current revision. Migrations create base tables, rename to plural, add tasks/activity-logs/documents/indexes, drop and recreate `authorizations_view` (gated by `status = 1`), seed permissions/org-status/lookup tables, add product codes and subscriptions, backfill via `ProductService.update_org_product_keycloak_groups(org_id)` and BCOL API calls to `Product.create_subscription_from_bcol_profile`. Terms-of-use migrations insert/patch `documents` by `(version_id, type)`. Legal-api starts at `98ccc973c01d`, builds audit `*_version` tables, adds offices/batches/configurations/furnishings/reviews/digital-credentials/amalgamations. Serialization: models pass to Marshmallow schemas; `BaseSchema` dumps and `_remove_empty` drops None; `OrgSchema._include_dynamic_fields` adds `businessName`; public schemas call `mask_email`. No permission checks shown. GOTCHA: Seeds lack duplicate guards; migrations downgrade to nothing or delete by fixed id, risking partial data loss; no explicit transactions; schema changes must manually mirror in serializers (`OrgSchema`, `MembershipSchema` `only`/`exclude` lists); docs snapshot different dates with column/table disagreements.

Test suite and production code that render PDFs for business filings and documents, validating filings, and managing filing lifecycle.

**Entry points:** GET `/api/v1` and `/api/v2` REST resources for filings, documents, receipts; POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE on `ListFilingResource` to create, update, cancel or delete filings. No check shown for who may call. Filing creation via POST becomes DRAFT, or PENDING when payment service returns `paymentToken`; PATCH cancels payment (PENDING→DRAFT); completed filings cannot delete. Validators run on creation.

**Rendering flow:** GET with `accept: application/pdf` on filing resource picks `report_key`. Static keys fetch from Minio via `_get_static_report()`; others call `_format_filing_json()` dispatcher and `VersionedBusinessDetailsService` diff, then POST `{reportName, template, templateVars}` to report service. Non-200 response returns error JSON. Business document PDF adds addresses, parties, registrar data via `RegistrarInfo.get_registrar_info`, POSTs to report service, returns data without rendering via `get_json()`. Furnishing notice builds HTML, POSTs to Gotenberg, returns content or `None` on failure. Multiple filings return 406; unknown type returns 404. Filing documents return receipt URL and conditional certificate entries; PENDING or PAPER_ONLY returns 404.

**Decisions:** Unknown filing type → 404 "Available on paper only"; filing status (PENDING/PAPER_ONLY) → 404 on documents request; `DocumentMetaService.get_documents` decides which documents a filing offers; `validate_document_request` gates requests; completion status → delete blocked.

**Saved state:** Filing created as DRAFT before payment; no retry on payment-service failure shown; `report_v2.get_pdf()` returns `None` without logging on Gotenberg failure.

GOTCHA: Payment-service failures not retried; filing can stay PENDING. Furnishing PDF returns `None` silently without logging. Gold-file loader turns unreadable file into `{}`. Tests bypass real transitions with `skip_status_listener=True`. Share class rules duplicated across model and three validators, may diverge.

Display-only Vue UI that shows contextual alert panels and a dismissible legal-obligation card on the business dashboard, for the business dashboard system. It reads state from `useBusinessStore` and `useRootStore`, makes no API calls, and outputs only Vue events.

**Alert display**: Computed `alerts` reads store flags in priority order (`isInDissolutionAlert`, `isAmalgamationAlert`, `isDisableNonBenCorps`, `isFrozenInformationAlert`, `isMissingInformationAlert`, `isNotInComplianceAlert`, `isNotInGoodStandingAlert`), adds one alert component per active flag, and emits `count` on mount and change. **Panel expansion**: User clicks `details-btn` (only clickable part; header ignores pointer events) → alert emits `togglePanel` → `Alerts.vue` togglePanel(index) stores open index as index or NaN → panel re-renders with `showPanel` true, button text changes. **Warning dates**: Amalgamation takes `FUTURE_EFFECTIVE_AMALGAMATION` warning and formats with `DateUtilities.apiToPacificDate`; InDissolution takes `INVOLUNTARY_DISSOLUTION` warning and formats `targetDissolutionDate`, shows "Unknown" if missing. **Phone hiding**: FrozenInformation and MissingInformation compute `hidePhoneNumbers` as `isEntityFirm` AND `show-alert-phone-numbers-firm` flag off, pass to `ContactInfo`. **Legal card**: `LegalObligation.vue` watches `isActive` (immediate) → sets `showLegalObligation` → renders only if `showLegalObligation`, `getObligations`, `isBusinessWithNoMaintenanceFilings`, and `isBusiness` (meaning `BUSINESS_ID` in `sessionStorage`) are all true. "Read more" expands subtitle, `includedChanges` list, `detailInfoURL` link. Dismiss sets `showLegalObligation = false` locally (not persisted).

**Entry points**: No checks shown. Alert panels and legal card are rendered conditionally by store flags; no caller check enforced by this chunk.

GOTCHA: Alert order and flag-to-component mapping live only in `Alerts.vue` computed; new alert addition there is required or it will not appear. Open panel index can point at wrong alert if list changes. Amalgamation and InDissolution read warnings without guard; missing warning or date gives wrong or empty value (only InDissolution falls back to "Unknown"). `DissolutionVoluntary` suite is skipped, so completed-dissolution wording untested. Specs override store computeds directly and do not test alert combinations or priority.

structured.condensed:
FAS routing slips management in pay-api: handles creation, linking, status transitions, refunds and reporting of financial routing slips via `/api/v1/fas/routing-slips` endpoints.

**Entry points:** Create (needs FAS_CREATE, FAS_SEARCH) writes PaymentAccount, CfsAccount (PENDING), RoutingSlip (ACTIVE, remaining_amount=total), Payment rows (COMPLETED, is_routing_slip=True), commits, returns 201. Link child to parent (POST /links, after _validate_linking) raises RS_* errors (RS_ALREADY_LINKED, RS_CHILD_HAS_TRANSACTIONS) as 400 with type code; do_link moves child's remaining_amount to parent, sets child LINKED with 0, commits. Update status (PATCH UPDATE_STATUS) validates via STATUS_TRANSITIONS table; disallowed raises FAS_INVALID_RS_STATUS_CHANGE. _check_roles_for_status_update requires FAS_VOID, FAS_CORRECTION or FAS_REFUND_APPROVER per target. NSF negates children's totals into remaining_amount; VOID blocked if invoices exist, zeroes remaining_amount; CORRECTION recalculates total, may return to ACTIVE or COMPLETE. Four-eyes rule: requester cannot authorize own refund/write-off. Refund flow: ACTIVE→REFUND_REQUESTED (stores mailingAddress in refund.details, returns 202), different user with FAS_REFUND_APPROVER moves to REFUND_AUTHORIZED or WRITE_OFF_AUTHORIZED; can cancel or reject (returns to ACTIVE). Comments: create raises FAS_INVALID_ROUTING_SLIP_NUMBER for missing slip, flushes, commits. Search takes filter/page/limit, returns {total, page, limit, items} via RoutingSlipSchema. find_by_number adds allowedStatuses. create_daily_reports selects by dateFilter, excludes VOID, totals cash/cheque counts and USD/CAD amounts, posts to REPORT_API_BASE_URL via OAuthService.post.

**GOTCHA:** No locking or rollback around multi-record changes (NSF reversal sums children unguarded, do_link and create lack duplicate-submit guard). Transition rules in STATUS_TRANSITIONS table, CORRECTION branch, seeded codes, and per-role tests can drift. Migration 7aff4af4be85 downgrade resets every COMPLETE slip with remaining_amount < 0.01 to ACTIVE, including already-COMPLETE slips. parent_id → parent_number migration shows no data copy; existing links may be lost. CFS call sequences non-atomic, no stated idempotency; mid-sequence failure leaves local and CFS state out of step.
